502.description: The sync server answered with an unexpected error.

503.description: This server cannot reach the sync server; the role / active changes were not made.

post.summary: Deactivates an account: it can no longer sign in and stops counting as a seat.
post.description:
Requires `ManageUsers` and an `Idempotency-Key`; no body. Same rules as
`PATCH { "isActive": false }` - an Organization Admin needs a removal request instead. Already
inactive → 200 unchanged. Example:
`POST /api/v1/users/8f0c3c1e-2b6d-4c55-9a51-0d3f3c1b7e21/deactivate`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User id (string GUID).

403.description: A hierarchy rule refused it (an Organization Admin needs a removal request).

404.description: No such user in this organization.

409.description: The key's creator is unknown on this server, or it would remove the organization's last active Organization Admin.

502.description: The sync server answered with an unexpected error.

503.description: This server cannot reach the sync server; nothing was changed.

post.summary: Reactivates a deactivated account.
post.description:
Requires `ManageUsers` and an `Idempotency-Key`; no body. Same rules as
`PATCH { "isActive": true }`, including the grant limit: every permission the account holds
must be held by the API key and its creator. Already active → 200 unchanged. Example:
`POST /api/v1/users/8f0c3c1e-2b6d-4c55-9a51-0d3f3c1b7e21/reactivate`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User id (string GUID).

403.description: A hierarchy or grant rule refused it.

404.description: No such user in this organization.

409.description: The key's creator is unknown on this server.

502.description: The sync server answered with an unexpected error.

503.description: This server cannot reach the sync server; nothing was changed.

post.summary: Asks to demote or deactivate an Organization Admin (or steps the key's creator down).
post.description:
Requires `ManageUsers` and an `Idempotency-Key`. The key's creator must be an active
Organization Admin (a System Admin changes roles directly instead) and id an
Organization Admin of the same organization with no other pending request. The target is notified
(in the app and by e-mail) and can approve it (applies at once) or contest it until
`effectiveAt`, 14 days from now; otherwise it is applied shortly after that. When
id is the key's creator, it is their own approval and applies at once (200).
Refused (409) when it would leave the organization with no active Organization Admin. Example:
`POST /api/v1/users/8f0c3c1e-2b6d-4c55-9a51-0d3f3c1b7e21/removal-requests { "action": "Demote", "newRole": "Manager" }`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User id (string GUID) of the Organization Admin to remove.

200.description: Self-removal: the change was made (`applied: true`).

201.description: Requested; `Location` points at the list.

403.description: The key's creator may not request this (not an Organization Admin, or a System Admin).

404.description: No such user in this organization.

409.description: A request for this admin is already pending, it would remove the last active Organization Admin, or the key's creator is unknown here.

422.description: The account is not an Organization Admin, `newRole` is missing, or the account is already inactive.

502.description: The sync server answered with an unexpected error.

503.description: This server cannot reach the sync server; nothing was requested.

post.summary: The admin being removed agrees: the change is made now.
post.description:
Requires `ManageUsers` and an `Idempotency-Key`; no body. Only the admin named in the
request (the key's creator must be them) can approve, at any time while it is `Pending` -
also after `effectiveAt` if it has not been applied yet. Refused (409) once closed, or when it
would remove the last active Organization Admin (the request then closes as `Cancelled`). Example:
`POST /api/v1/users/8f0c3c1e-2b6d-4c55-9a51-0d3f3c1b7e21/removal-requests/12/approve`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User id (string GUID) of the admin named in the request.

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description: Removal request id from `GET /api/v1/users/removal-requests`.

403.description: The key's creator is not the admin named in the request.

404.description: No such request for this user in this organization.

409.description: The request is no longer pending, the change can no longer apply, or the key's creator is unknown here.

502.description: The sync server answered with an unexpected error.

503.description: This server cannot reach the sync server; nothing changed.

post.summary: The requester withdraws a pending removal request.
post.description:
Requires `ManageUsers` and an `Idempotency-Key`; no body. Only the admin who asked (the
key's creator must be them) or a System Admin, while the request is `Pending`. Example:
`POST /api/v1/users/8f0c3c1e-2b6d-4c55-9a51-0d3f3c1b7e21/removal-requests/12/cancel`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User id (string GUID) of the admin named in the request.

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description: Removal request id from `GET /api/v1/users/removal-requests`.

403.description: The key's creator did not make the request.

404.description: No such request for this user in this organization.

409.description: The request is no longer pending, or the key's creator is unknown here.

502.description: The sync server answered with an unexpected error.

503.description: This server cannot reach the sync server; nothing changed.

post.summary: The admin being removed objects: the request closes and nothing changes.
post.description:
Requires `ManageUsers` and an `Idempotency-Key`; no body. Only the admin named in the
request (the key's creator must be them), and only before `effectiveAt`: after the 14-day
notice period it can no longer be contested (409). Example:
`POST /api/v1/users/8f0c3c1e-2b6d-4c55-9a51-0d3f3c1b7e21/removal-requests/12/contest`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User id (string GUID) of the admin named in the request.

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description: Removal request id from `GET /api/v1/users/removal-requests`.

403.description: The key's creator is not the admin named in the request.

404.description: No such request for this user in this organization.

409.description: The request is no longer pending, the notice period has ended, or the key's creator is unknown here.

502.description: The sync server answered with an unexpected error.

503.description: This server cannot reach the sync server; nothing changed.

get.summary: Lists the organization's Organization Admin removal requests, pending first.
get.description:
Requires `ManageUsers`. Not cursor-paginated: pending requests plus (with
`includeClosed=true`) the latest closed ones, at most 100, in one response with
`nextCursor` always `null`. Sends a weak `ETag`. Example:
`GET /api/v1/users/removal-requests?includeClosed=true`.
Also available as CSV (`Accept: text/csv` or `?format=csv`); paging cursor in `X-Next-Cursor`.

parameters.name: includeClosed
parameters.description: Also return approved, contested, cancelled and applied requests (default `false`).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Alternative to the Accept header: `csv` returns text/csv.

X-Next-Cursor.description: text/csv only: the page's nextCursor. Absent on the last page. Pass it as ?after= (or follow the Link header) to fetch the next page.

Link.description: text/csv only, alongside X-Next-Cursor: <absolute URL of the next page>; rel="next".

schema.description: CSV document: UTF-8 with BOM, CRLF rows, RFC 4180 quoting. The header row holds the JSON property names of one item (nested objects flattened as parent.child); one row per item of the page.

403.description: The key's creator is not an Organization Admin.

409.description: The key's creator is unknown on this server.

502.description: The sync server answered with an unexpected error.

503.description: This server cannot reach the sync server.

get.summary: Lists the organization's vendors, one page at a time.
get.description:
Requires `ViewPurchaseOrders`. Deactivated vendors are excluded unless
`includeInactive=true`. Cursor-paginated: pass `nextCursor` as `after`.
Example: `GET /api/v1/vendors?search=acme`.
Also available as CSV (`Accept: text/csv` or `?format=csv`); paging cursor in `X-Next-Cursor`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match against name, contact name and contact email. Example: `acme`.

parameters.name: includeInactive
parameters.description: Also return deactivated vendors (default `false`).

parameters.name: updatedSince
parameters.description: Only vendors created or updated at/after this instant (ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. `2026-09-01T00:00:00Z`).

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor from the previous page's `nextCursor` (a vendor SyncId). Omit for the first page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1..200 (default 50).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Alternative to the Accept header: `csv` returns text/csv.

200.description: One page of vendors and the cursor for the next page (null on the last page).

X-Next-Cursor.description: text/csv only: the page's nextCursor. Absent on the last page. Pass it as ?after= (or follow the Link header) to fetch the next page.

Link.description: text/csv only, alongside X-Next-Cursor: <absolute URL of the next page>; rel="next".

schema.description: CSV document: UTF-8 with BOM, CRLF rows, RFC 4180 quoting. The header row holds the JSON property names of one item (nested objects flattened as parent.child); one row per item of the page.

post.summary: Creates a vendor.
post.description:
Requires `ManageVendors` and an `Idempotency-Key` header. Same as "New Vendor" in the
app: the name must be unique in the organization (active or not). Attributed to the key's creator.
Example: `{ "name": "Acme Supply", "contactEmail": "orders@acme.example" }`.

201.description: Created; `Location` points at the new vendor.

409.description: A vendor with this name already exists, or the key's creator is unknown on this server.

422.description: A field is unacceptable (blank name, invalid email, too long); the field is listed in `errors`.

get.summary: Returns one vendor.
get.description: Requires `ViewPurchaseOrders`. `id` may be the numeric id or the `syncId`. Sends a weak `ETag`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id or SyncId. Example: `7`.

404.description: No such vendor in this organization.

patch.summary: Edits a vendor; only the fields sent change.
patch.description:
Requires `ManageVendors` and an `Idempotency-Key` header. `""` clears a field
(not `name`); `"isActive": false` deactivates the vendor. Renaming onto another vendor's
name is refused. Existing purchase orders keep the vendor name they were placed with.
Example: `PATCH /api/v1/vendors/7 { "contactPhone": "555-0199" }`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric vendor id. Example: `7`.

404.description: No such vendor in this organization.

409.description: Another vendor already has this name, or the key's creator is unknown on this server.

422.description: A field is unacceptable; the field is listed in `errors`.

get.summary: Lists the organization's webhook subscriptions.
get.description: Requires `ManageOrganizations`. The signing secret is never returned here — only once, when the subscription is created.

post.summary: Registers a webhook subscription (an instant-trigger endpoint).
post.description: Requires `ManageOrganizations` and an `Idempotency-Key` header. The response includes the HMAC `signingSecret`once — store it to verify the `X-Flex-Signature-V2` (timestamped, replay-safe) and `X-Flex-Signature` headers; it is never retrievable again. The URL must be a public `https` endpoint. Attributed to the key's creator. Example: `{ "url": "https://hooks.zapier.com/…", "events": ["job.completed"] }`.

requestBody.description: The target URL and the events to subscribe to.

201.description: Created; `Location` points at the subscription. Body includes `signingSecret`.

409.description: The key's creator is unknown on this server.

422.description: The URL or events are unacceptable; the field is listed in `errors`.

delete.description: Requires `ManageOrganizations`. Idempotent: deleting an already-deleted or unknown subscription returns `404`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric subscription id. Example: `42`.

404.description: No such subscription in this organization.

get.summary: Lists the event names a subscription can subscribe to.
get.description:
Requires `ManageOrganizations`. Use these values in the `events` array of
`POST /api/v1/webhooks`. Integration platforms use this to populate a trigger picker.
Example: `GET /api/v1/webhooks/events`.

name.description: Charge name shown on the estimate, ≤ 200 characters. Required. Example: `Disposal fee`.

price.description: Amount charged to the customer, in the organization's currency, ≥ 0. Example: `75.00`.

description.description: Optional longer description, ≤ 500 characters.

AddJobChargeApiRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/charges`: add a custom charge.

itemTemplateId.description: Item template id from `GET /api/v1/items`; must belong to your organization. Parent, sell-by-unit and add-on items are added through the app instead.

unitCost.description: Cost per unit to the organization, in its currency, ≥ 0. Omit to use the template's base cost. Example: `12.50`.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit charged to the customer, ≥ 0. Omit to let pricing resolve the tier/base price; a value that differs from the base price is kept as a manual override. Example: `19.99`.

notes.description: Line note, ≤ 500 characters.

AddJobItemApiRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/items`: add a material line.

description.description: What the labor is, ≤ 200 characters. Required. Example: `Install and commission unit`.

laborRateId.description: Id of one of your organization's labor rates. The customer rate is that rate's hourly figure × `multiplier`.

taskTemplateId.description: Optional task template id (must belong to your organization).

multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the labor rate's hourly rate (default 1). Example: `1.5` for overtime.

customerPrice.description: Explicit per-job customer price for $0-rate variable-price labor, in the organization's currency, ≥ 0. Omit to bill rate × hours.

notes.description: Line note, ≤ 500 characters.

AddJobLaborApiRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/labor`: add a labor line.

lines.description: Lines to add, 1–200 entries, each as on create; checked before anything is written. A line for an item already on the order (not in a live transfer) is merged into it, as the app does.

locationId.description:
Stock location the units are added to / removed from (see `GET /api/v1/locations`).
Omit or null for the organization's "No Location" bucket. Job sites are refused (422).

delta.description:
Whole units to add (positive) or remove (negative); never zero. Removal takes the oldest
available units first and is refused with 409 when fewer are on hand than requested.
Example: `5` receives five units, `-1` writes one off. At most 1000 units per call
(each unit is a physical stock row); split larger changes into several calls.

reason.description: Optional reason recorded in each unit's change history (e.g. `"Cycle count"`). Max 500 characters.

AdjustStockRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/items/{id}/stock/adjust`: add or remove whole units of an item
at one stock location. Example: `{ "locationId": 3, "delta": -2, "reason": "Damaged in van" }`.

applied.description: True when this call demoted / deactivated the account (approval or self-removal).

message.description: What happened. Example: `"Removal requested: pat@example.com will be demoted to Manager on 2026-10-07 (UTC) unless they contest it, or sooner if they approve."`

AdminRemovalOutcomeDto.description: Answer of the removal-request writes: the request after the call, and whether the change was made by it.

id.description: Request id. Example: `12`.

targetUserId.description: User id (string GUID) of the Organization Admin being removed. Example: `"8f0c3c1e-2b6d-4c55-9a51-0d3f3c1b7e21"`.

targetEmail.description: E-mail of the admin being removed. Example: `"pat@example.com"`.

targetName.description: Display name of the admin being removed, when recorded. Example: `"Pat Lee"`.

requestedByUserId.description: User id (string GUID) of the Organization Admin who asked; the same as `targetUserId` for a self-removal.

requestedByEmail.description: E-mail of the admin who asked. Example: `"sam@example.com"`.

requestedByName.description: Display name of the admin who asked, when recorded. Example: `"Sam Carter"`.

reason.description: The requester's optional note (up to 500 characters). Example: `"Leaving the company on Friday"`.

createdAt.description: When it was requested (ISO-8601 UTC). Example: `"2026-09-23T14:05:00Z"`.

effectiveAt.description:
End of the notice period (ISO-8601 UTC, `createdAt` + 14 days; equal to `createdAt` for a
self-removal): the target can contest until then, and it is applied shortly after. Example: `"2026-10-07T14:05:00Z"`.

daysRemaining.description: Whole days left until `effectiveAt`, rounded up; 0 once it has passed or the request is closed. Example: `14`.

resolvedAt.description: When the request closed (ISO-8601 UTC); null while `Pending`.

resolvedByEmail.description: E-mail of whoever closed it; null when the notice period ran out or it lapsed.

resolutionNote.description: Why a request lapsed or was superseded. Example: `"The requester is no longer an active Organization Admin."`

AdminRemovalRequestDto.description:
A request to demote or deactivate an Organization Admin. Removing one needs the admin's own
approval or a 14-day notice period during which they can contest it.

id.description: Log row id, increasing in the order rows were written; also the pagination cursor. Example: `48213`.

apiKeyId.description: Id of the API key that made the request (see Settings → Integrations → API Keys). Example: `3`.

keyName.description: Name the key was given at creation; null when the key no longer exists. Example: `"Claude assistant"`.

keyPrefix.description: Non-secret key prefix shown on the API Keys page. Example: `"flx_live_a1b2c3d4"`.

path.description: Request path without the query string. Example: `"/api/v1/jobs/42/status"` or `"/mcp"`.

mcpMethod.description: For `/mcp` requests, the JSON-RPC method (`"tools/call"`, `"tools/list"`, `"initialize"`, ...; `"batch"` for a JSON-RPC batch); null for `/api/v1`.

mcpTool.description: For an MCP `tools/call`, the tool that was called; null otherwise. Example: `"update_job_status"`.

statusCode.description: HTTP status code returned. An MCP tool failure is still `200` (the error is inside the JSON-RPC result). Example: `201`.

durationMs.description: Server processing time in milliseconds. Example: `37`.

remoteIp.description: Client IP address as seen by the server. Example: `"203.0.113.9"`.

createdAt.description: UTC time the request started (ISO-8601). Example: `"2026-09-23T14:05:11Z"`.

authFailure.description:
Why a genuine key was refused before reaching the endpoint: `"key_expired"` (status
`401`, the key's expiry had passed) or `"ip_not_allowed"` (status `403`, the
client IP is outside the key's allowed IP ranges). Null for every other request, including
permission denials. Example: `"ip_not_allowed"`.

ApiActivityDto.description:
One logged request to `/api/v1` or `/mcp` made with one of the calling
organization's API keys, as returned by `GET /api/v1/activity` — "what did the
integration or AI agent do". Never carries the token, request bodies or tool arguments.
Rows are kept 90 days.

ApiAdminRemovalAction.description: What a removal request does to the Organization Admin.

ApiAdminRemovalStatus.description: Where a removal request stands. Only `Pending` is open.

ApiAssignableRole.description:
A standard role an API caller may assign. `SystemAdmin` is never assignable through the API.
Ranked OrganizationAdmin (3) > Manager (2) > User (1).

ApiDemotionRole.description: A role an Organization Admin may be demoted to.

id.description: Id of the resource the operation acted on (e.g. the job id).

message.description: Human-readable confirmation from the service (e.g. "Job started."). May be null.

warning.description: Non-fatal problem encountered while completing the operation (e.g. a notification email that could not be sent). Null when there was none.

ApiOperationResponse.description:
Body of a successful workflow-style write that has no richer resource to return
(assign, start, complete, void…). Id is the affected resource's id;
Warning carries a non-fatal note from the service (e.g. an email that
could not be sent).

userIds.description: Identity user ids (see `GET /api/v1/users`) to assign. All must be active members of the organization.

replace.description:
`true`: the list becomes the complete set of assignees (people not listed are
            unassigned; an empty list unassigns everyone). `false` (default): the listed
            people are added to whoever is already assigned.

reason.description: Why the job is being cancelled (recorded on the job; "No reason provided" when omitted).

issueStoreCredit.description:
When the job holds an uncollected down payment, convert it to customer store credit
instead of blocking the cancellation. Requires the key to hold `ManageStoreCredit`.

reason.description: Why the order is cancelled, up to 500 characters; omitted or blank = `No reason provided` (as the app's Cancel page). Example: `Customer changed their mind`.

CancelSalesOrderApiRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/v1/sales-orders/{id}/cancel`; optional. Example: `{ "reason": "Customer changed their mind" }`.

id.description: The deleted category's id, e.g. `4`.

reassignedItemCount.description: Items whose primary `categoryId` was this category and now is the organization's default "No Category" (not listed by the API).

removedAssignmentCount.description: Item and inventory-unit category assignments removed with the category.

CategoryDeletedResponse.description: Body of `DELETE /api/v1/categories/{id}`: what the delete changed.

id.description: Numeric category id, e.g. `4`; the `categoryId` of items and the id used by `/api/v1/categories/{id}/properties`.

syncId.description: Globally unique sync id (GUID). Use it as the `after` pagination cursor.

name.description: Category name, e.g. `"Lumber"`.

description.description: Optional description; null when unset.

parentCategoryId.description: Id of the parent category; null for a top-level category.

isTemplateBuilderCategory.description: True when the category was generated by a Template Builder (its name and place in the tree are managed there, not on the Item Categories page).

updatedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the last edit of the category itself; null when never edited. Property changes do not move it.

CategoryDto.description:
An item category of the calling organization, as returned by `GET /api/v1/categories`.
Categories form a tree via `parentCategoryId`; an item's `categoryId` points here.
System categories (the built-in "No Category") are not listed.

properties.description: Own and inherited properties; a property of this category overrides a parent's of the same name.

CategoryPropertiesResponse.description:
Body of `GET /api/v1/categories/{id}/properties` and of every category-property write: the
category's properties — its own plus those inherited from parent categories — ordered by
`displayOrder`.

id.description: Property id, e.g. `57`; used by `PATCH` / `DELETE /api/v1/categories/{categoryId}/properties/{propertyId}` (on the defining category).

categoryId.description: Id of the category that defines the property: this category, or a parent when `isInherited`.

name.description: Property name, e.g. `"Species"` (unique per category, case-insensitive).

defaultValue.description: Default value items get when the property is copied to them, in the type's format (numbers `"12.5"`, booleans `"true"`/`"false"`, dates `yyyy-MM-dd`); `""` = none.

options.description: Allowed values for `Dropdown` / `MultiSelect`, e.g. `["Pine","Oak"]`; empty for other types.

isRequired.description: True when the property is marked required in the app.

displayOrder.description: Sort position (ascending) in which the app lists the category's properties, e.g. `0`.

isInherited.description: True when the property is defined on a parent category (edit it there).

overridesParent.description: True when this category's property overrides a parent category's property of the same name.

CategoryPropertyDto.description: One property (custom-field definition) that items in a category carry.

failedLines.description: Lines (ids from the transfer's `lines[].id`) to mark failed before completing; they stay where they are instead of moving. Up to 100.

CompleteTransferRequest.description:
Optional body of `POST /api/v1/transfers/{id}/complete`: lines that did not arrive.
Example: `{ "failedLines": [ { "lineId": 911, "reason": "Damaged in transit" } ] }`. Omit
the body (or send `{}`) when everything arrived.

reason.description: Optional note shown to the admin being removed, up to 500 characters. Example: `"Leaving the company on Friday"`.

CreateAdminRemovalApiRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/users/{id}/removal-requests`. Examples:
`{ "action": "Demote", "newRole": "Manager", "reason": "Moving to the field team" }`,
`{ "action": "Deactivate" }`.

name.description: Category name, 1-100 characters (trimmed), unique among the categories with the same parent (case-insensitive), e.g. `"Hardwood"`.

description.description: Optional description, at most 2000 characters; blank is stored as none.

parentCategoryId.description: Parent category id (a category of your organization that is not Template Builder-generated), e.g. `1`; omit, null or `0` for a top-level category.

name.description: Property name, 1-100 characters, unique in the category (case-insensitive); `Cost` and `Unit Price` are reserved.

defaultValue.description: Optional default value in the type's format (see `defaultValue` on GET), at most 4000 characters; a `Dropdown` / `MultiSelect` default must be among `options`. A required `Boolean` defaults to `"false"`.

options.description: Options for a `Dropdown` / `MultiSelect` property (at most 200, each 1-200 characters, no commas, no duplicates); refused for other types.

isRequired.description: Marks the property required in the app (default false).

displayOrder.description: Sort position, 0 or more; omitted = after the category's last property.

jobId.description: Numeric id of the job to bill.

invoiceNumber.description: Invoice number. Defaults to `INV-{jobNumber}`, or `INV-{jobNumber}-{n}` for the n-th invoice on the job.

invoiceDate.description: Issue date (UTC, date part only). Defaults to today.

dueDate.description: Due date (UTC, date part only). Defaults from the customer's payment terms; must not precede `invoiceDate`.

taxRate.description: Tax rate percentage. Defaults to the job's rate; always 0 for a tax-exempt customer.

terms.description: Payment terms text printed on the invoice. Defaults to the customer's terms (e.g. "Net 30").

notes.description: Notes shown to the customer.

paymentInstructions.description: Payment instructions printed on the invoice. Defaults to the organization's default instructions.

applyStoreCredit.description: Apply `storeCreditToApply` of the customer's store credit to the new invoice.

storeCreditToApply.description: Store credit amount to apply when `applyStoreCredit` is true (capped at the customer's balance and the invoice balance). Ignored otherwise.

CreateInvoiceFromJobRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/invoices/from-job`. Only `jobId` is required; every
omitted field defaults exactly as the Generate Invoice page does (number
`INV-{jobNumber}` or `INV-{jobNumber}-{n}`, today, due date from the customer's
payment terms, the job's tax rate, the organization's payment instructions). Amounts are
never accepted: the subtotal and taxable portion come from the job — or, once a finalized
invoice exists, from its unbilled remainder (a supplemental invoice).

name.description: Display name; required, 1-100 characters. An active item with the same name is refused (409).

description.description: Optional free-text description, max 2000 characters.

categoryId.description: Primary category id (see the item's `categoryId` on GET). Omit or null for the organization's default "No Category". Unknown or another organization's id → 422.

unitPrice.description: Starting selling price, 0 or more, stored to 2 decimals as the `Unit Price` property. Omit for 0.

cost.description: Starting purchase cost, 0 or more, stored to 2 decimals as the `Cost` property. Omit for 0.

CreateItemApiRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/items`: create a catalog item (template). Same rules as adding an
item in the app: the organization's default category when `categoryId` is omitted,
`Cost` and `Unit Price` properties created (0 unless supplied) and the category's
properties copied onto the item. Example:
`{ "name": "1/2\" PEX Coupling", "categoryId": 4, "unitPrice": 1.25, "cost": 0.40 }`.

name.description: Property name, 1-100 characters, unique on the item (case-insensitive); `Cost` and `Unit Price` are reserved.

value.description: Starting value in the type's format (see `value` on GET), at most 4000 characters; omit for none.

CreateItemPropertyApiRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/items/{id}/properties`: add an item-level custom field to one item.
Example: `{ "name": "Warranty (years)", "dataType": "Number", "value": "2" }`.

customerId.description: Customer the job is for (must belong to the key's organization).

customerAddressId.description: Optional site address id; must belong to `customerId`.

jobNumber.description: Optional job number. Omit to have one generated; a duplicate is suffixed to stay unique.

description.description: Short description of the work, shown in lists. ≤ 500 characters. Example: `Replace water heater`.

notes.description: Free-form internal notes (not shown to the customer). No length limit.

isDraft.description:
Save as a draft (status `Draft`) instead of an estimate. Ignored when
`statusId` / `statusKey` is given.

publishImmediately.description:
Create and publish in one call — the "Create & Publish" button. The job starts as a
`Draft` and is then published exactly as `POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/finalize` would
(needs at least one charge and a unit price on every material line), landing on
`Estimated`, or `Scheduled` when `scheduledDate` is given. When it cannot
be published yet the job is still created as a `Draft` (201) and `warning` on the
response says why. Takes precedence over `isDraft`; 400 when `statusId` /
`statusKey` names a non-Draft status. Default `false`.

statusId.description: Initial status definition id (one of the org's statuses). Mutually exclusive with `statusKey`.

statusKey.description:
Initial status by name — a status definition name (case-insensitive) or a system
status key such as `Draft`, `Estimated`, `Scheduled`. Mutually
exclusive with `statusId`.

scheduledDate.description: Scheduled start as the organization's local wall clock, `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss` with no UTC offset (the `date-time` format here is a local time, not RFC 3339 with zone); a trailing `Z` is converted to local time. Example: `2026-09-08T08:30:00`.

estimateChecklistTemplateId.description: Optional id of one of the organization's estimate pre-inspection checklist templates; its sections and items are copied onto the job.

items.description: Material lines (item templates with quantity and pricing). May be empty.

laborItems.description: Labor lines (hours × rates). May be empty.

customCharges.description: Custom charges (fees, disposal, permits …) with a price and optional cost. May be empty.

CreateJobApiRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/jobs` (API_AND_MCP.md, Phase 1b). Mirrors what the MVC
Create page posts, minus the browser-only fields; totals are computed server-side
from the lines instead of being trusted from the client.

name.description: Charge name shown on the estimate, ≤ 200 characters. Required. Example: `Disposal fee`.

description.description: Optional longer description, ≤ 500 characters.

price.description: Amount charged to the customer, in the organization's currency, ≥ 0. Example: `75.00`.

cost.description: Cost to the organization (for margin), in its currency, ≥ 0. Default 0.

CreateJobCustomChargeApiRequest.description: A custom charge on a new job.

itemTemplateId.description: Item template id from `GET /api/v1/items`; must belong to the key's organization.

unitCost.description: Cost per unit to the organization, in its currency, ≥ 0. Example: `12.50`.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit charged to the customer, in the organization's currency, ≥ 0. Example: `19.99`.

discountPercent.description: Line discount as a percentage, 0–100 (`10` = 10 % off `quantity` × `unitPrice`). Default 0.

notes.description: Line note, ≤ 500 characters.

CreateJobItemApiRequest.description: A material line on a new job.

description.description: What the labor is, ≤ 200 characters. Required. Example: `Install and commission unit`.

taskTemplateId.description: Optional id of the organization's task template this line derives from.

laborRateId.description: Optional id of the organization's labor rate the hourly figures were taken from (the figures themselves are still sent explicitly).

customerRate.description: Hourly rate billed to the customer.

notes.description: Line note, ≤ 500 characters.

CreateJobLaborApiRequest.description: A labor line on a new job.

orderNumber.description:
PO number, up to 50 characters. Omit to have one generated the way the app does:
`{vendor name, letters and digits}-{yyyy-MM-dd}-{nnnn}` (e.g. `AcmeSupply-2026-09-22-0001`),
or `PO-{yyyy}-{nnnn}` without a vendor.

externalOrderNumber.description: The vendor's own order or confirmation number, up to 50 characters. Example: `SO-88213`.

vendorId.description: An active vendor from `GET /api/v1/vendors`. Omit for a one-off vendor named in `vendorName`. Example: `7`.

vendorName.description: Vendor name on the order, up to 200 characters. Defaults to the vendor record's name when `vendorId` is given.

vendorContactEmail.description: Contact email for this order, up to 100 characters. Defaults to the vendor record's contact email.

vendorContactPhone.description: Contact phone for this order, up to 20 characters. Defaults to the vendor record's contact phone.

orderDate.description: Order date (organization-local calendar date, no offset). Defaults to today. Example: `2026-09-22`.

expectedDeliveryDate.description: Expected delivery date (organization-local calendar date, no offset); optional. Example: `2026-09-30`.

totalCost.description: Order total as agreed with the vendor, in `currency`; optional. Example: `74.40`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, 3 letters. Defaults to `USD`.

receivingLocationId.description: Where the order will be received: an active, top-level location that is not a job site (see `GET /api/v1/locations?parentLocationId=0`). Example: `1`.

notes.description: Free-text notes on the order.

lines.description: Lines to order, 0..200, in display order. More can be added later with `POST /api/v1/purchase-orders/{id}/lines`.

CreatePurchaseOrderApiRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/purchase-orders`: a new `Draft` order, optionally with its lines.
Example: `{ "vendorId": 7, "receivingLocationId": 1, "lines": [ { "itemId": 12, "quantityOrdered": 24, "unitPrice": 3.10 } ] }`.

customerId.description: Customer the order is for (see `/api/v1/customers`); must be an existing customer of this organization that is not marked Difficult. Example: `42`.

customerPONumber.description: The customer's own purchase-order reference, up to 100 characters. Example: `PO-7781`.

deliveryAddressId.description: Id of one of the customer's addresses to deliver to (`/api/v1/customers/{id}/locations`); omit for none. Example: `77`.

orderDate.description: Order date, an organization-local calendar date (`yyyy-MM-dd`; no UTC offset). Defaults to today's date (server clock), like the New Sales Order page's pre-filled value. Example: `2026-09-23`.

requestedDeliveryDate.description: Requested delivery date, an organization-local calendar date (`yyyy-MM-dd`). Example: `2026-09-30`.

paymentTerms.description: Payment terms text, up to 100 characters. Defaults to the organization's default payment terms (else `Due on Receipt`). Example: `Net 30`.

taxRate.description: Tax rate in percent, 0–100 (8.25 = 8.25 %). Omit or send 0 for the organization's default tax rate; a tax-exempt customer always gets 0. Example: `8.25`.

notes.description: Free-text notes on the order. Example: `Leave at loading dock.`

lines.description:
Lines to add, 0–200 entries (an order with no lines can be filled in the app). Every line is
checked before anything is written; lines for the same item are merged into one line
(quantities add up, the later non-zero price wins), exactly as adding items in the app.

itemId.description: Catalog item id from `/api/v1/items`; must be a non-deleted item of this organization. Example: `5`.

unitPrice.description: Unit price in the organization's currency, 0–1,000,000,000; the line total is `quantity` × `unitPrice`, and the lines together may total at most 1,000,000,000,000 (else 422 on `lines`). Example: `125.00`.

unitCost.description: Unit cost in the organization's currency, 0–1,000,000,000; omit when unknown (stored as 0). Example: `80.00`.

notes.description: Line notes. Example: `Cut to 25 ft lengths`.

CreateSalesOrderLineApiRequest.description: One line of a sales-order create request.

customerId.description: Numeric id of the customer to bill (must be an active customer in your organization).

customerAddressId.description: Optional site address id (a location belonging to the customer) to print on the invoice.

invoiceNumber.description: Invoice number. Defaults to the next `INV-SA-…` number.

invoiceDate.description: Issue date (UTC, date part only). Defaults to today.

dueDate.description: Due date (UTC, date part only). Defaults from `paymentTerms`; must not precede `invoiceDate`.

description.description: Short description shown in lists.

taxRate.description: Tax rate percentage. Defaults to the organization's default rate; always 0 for a tax-exempt customer.

notes.description: Notes shown to the customer.

paymentInstructions.description: Payment instructions printed on the invoice. Defaults to the organization's default instructions.

lines.description: Lines to bill, in display order. At least one.

applyStoreCredit.description: Apply `storeCreditToApply` of the customer's store credit to the new invoice.

storeCreditToApply.description: Store credit amount to apply when `applyStoreCredit` is true (capped at the customer's balance and the invoice total). Ignored otherwise.

CreateStandaloneInvoiceApiRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/invoices` — a standalone invoice (not tied to a job) with its
own lines. Only `customerId` and at least one line are required; every omitted field
defaults exactly as the New Invoice page does (number `INV-SA-…`, today, the
organization's default payment terms, tax rate and payment instructions). The subtotal is
always the sum of the lines; it is never accepted directly.

sourceLocationId.description: Location the stock leaves (see `GET /api/v1/locations`). Must be active and must hold enough available units of every line's item. Example: `1`.

destinationLocationId.description: Location the stock arrives at; must be active and different from `sourceLocationId`. Example: `4`.

notes.description: Optional free-text note shown on the transfer, up to 2000 characters. Example: `Restock van 2`.

lines.description: What to move: 1–100 lines. Lines for the same item add up.

CreateTransferRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/transfers`: move whole units of catalog items from one location to
another (a standalone transfer, like Transfers → Create). Example:
`{ "sourceLocationId": 1, "destinationLocationId": 4, "notes": "Restock van 2", "lines": [ { "itemId": 12, "quantity": 3 } ] }`.

email.description: Login e-mail address, unique across Flex, up to 256 characters. Example: `"sam@example.com"`.

password.description:
Initial password: at least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a digit and a
symbol. Pass it to the person securely; they can change it under Account → Settings. Never
returned. Example: `"Welcome#2026"`.

customRoleId.description:
Optional custom role id (from `GET /api/v1/roles`) to add. The account then gets `User` as
its standard role, so leave `role` out or send `User`. Example: `4`.

url.description: The absolute `https` URL to POST events to. Public hosts only (no localhost/private ranges). Required.

events.description: The event names to subscribe to (at least one; see `GET /api/v1/webhooks/events`). Example: `["job.completed"]`.

CreateWebhookSubscriptionRequest.description: Request body for `POST /api/v1/webhooks` (register an instant-trigger endpoint).

name.description: Role name, 1..50 characters, unique in the organization and not a built-in role name. Example: `"Dispatcher"`.

description.description: Free-text description, up to 200 characters.

permissions.description:
FlexPermissions names the role grants (see `get_org_capabilities` / the permission catalog). Each
must be held both by the API key and by the key's creator. Example: `["ViewJobs", "ManageJobs"]`.

CustomRoleWriteApiRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/roles` (`name` required) and `PATCH /api/v1/roles/{id}` (only the
fields sent change; `permissions` replaces the whole set). Example:
`{ "name": "Dispatcher", "description": "Schedules crews", "permissions": ["ViewJobs", "ManageJobs"] }`.

id.description: Numeric id used in URLs (e.g. `/api/v1/customers/42`). Stable within this organization.

syncId.description: Globally unique sync id (GUID). Use it as the `after` pagination cursor and when correlating with offline devices.

name.description: Display name, e.g. `"Jane Doe"`. Always present.

companyName.description: Company / trading name when the customer is a business, e.g. `"Doe Roofing LLC"`.

primaryContact.description: Name of the primary contact person, if different from `name`.

phone.description: Main phone number as entered (no normalisation).

isTaxExempt.description: True when the customer is tax exempt; null when not recorded.

priceTier.description: Price tier applied to this customer: `Standard`, `Silver`, `Gold`, `Platinum` or `Custom`.

creditLimit.description: Credit limit in the organization's currency, e.g. `5000.00`.

currentBalance.description: Outstanding balance owed by the customer, e.g. `1250.50`.

storeCreditBalance.description: Store credit available to the customer, e.g. `0.00`.

status.description: Status flag: `None`, `Preferred` or `Difficult`.

warningNotes.description: Warning shown to staff when the customer is selected (e.g. `"Pays late"`).

notes.description: Free-form internal notes.

isActive.description: False when the customer has been deactivated (kept for history, hidden from pickers).

updatedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the last edit; null when never edited after creation.

CustomerDto.description:
A customer of the calling organization as returned by `GET /api/v1/customers` and
`GET /api/v1/customers/{id}`. Money values are decimals in the organization's
currency; dates are ISO-8601 UTC. Additional job-site addresses are a separate
collection at `/api/v1/customers/{id}/locations`.

id.description: Numeric id of the location. Stable within this organization.

syncId.description: Globally unique sync id (GUID). Use it as the `after` pagination cursor.

customerId.description: Id of the owning customer (matches the `{id}` in the URL).

name.description: Label given to the location, e.g. `"Main Office"` or `"Rental Property 1"`.

isMailingAddress.description: True when this is the customer's mailing address.

isActive.description: False when the location has been retired and should not be offered for new jobs.

notes.description: Free-text notes about the site (gate codes, parking), max 500 characters.

updatedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the last edit; null when never edited.

CustomerLocationDto.description:
An additional address / job site belonging to a customer, as returned by
`GET /api/v1/customers/{id}/locations`. Jobs can reference one of these as the
site to work at; the customer's primary address is on the customer itself.

name.description: Label for the location, 1–100 characters. Example: `"Main Office"`.

address.description: Street address line 1, up to 200 characters. Example: `"12 Oak St"`.

address2.description: Street address line 2 (suite, unit), up to 200 characters.

state.description: State / province, up to 50 characters. Example: `"IL"`.

postalCode.description: ZIP / postal code, up to 20 characters. Example: `"62701"`.

isMailingAddress.description:
True makes this the customer's mailing address and unmarks every other location of the
customer. Default `false` on create — except that a customer's first location is always
the mailing address.

isActive.description: False retires the location (kept for history, no longer offered for new jobs). Default `true` on create.

notes.description: Free-text notes about the site (gate codes, parking), up to 500 characters.

CustomerLocationWriteRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/customers/{id}/locations` and
`PATCH /api/v1/customers/{id}/locations/{locationId}`. On create, `name`,
`address`, `city`, `state` and `postalCode` are required (as on the
Customers → Addresses form). On PATCH only the fields sent change, `""` clears an optional
field, and the required ones cannot be cleared.
Example: `{ "name": "Rental Property 1", "address": "12 Oak St", "city": "Springfield", "state": "IL", "postalCode": "62701" }`.

name.description: Display name, e.g. `"Jane Doe"`. Required, ≤ 200 characters.

companyName.description: Company / trading name, e.g. `"Doe Roofing LLC"`. ≤ 200.

primaryContact.description: Primary contact person, if different from `name`. ≤ 100.

phone.description: Main phone number, stored as entered. ≤ 20.

mobilePhone.description: Mobile phone number, stored as entered. ≤ 20.

address.description: Primary (billing) street address line 1. ≤ 200. On create, any of address/city/state/postalCode also creates a "Primary Address" location.

country.description: Primary address country. ≤ 100. Defaults to `"USA"` on create.

isTaxExempt.description: True when tax exempt; null when not recorded.

creditLimit.description: Credit limit in the organization's currency, e.g. `5000.00`. Default 0.

isActive.description: Update only — false deactivates the customer (kept for history, hidden from pickers). Ignored on create; new customers are always active.

warningNotes.description: Warning shown to staff when the customer is selected. ≤ 1000.

notes.description: Free-form internal notes.

CustomerWriteRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/customers` and `PUT /api/v1/customers/{id}`. PUT replaces
every editable field, so send the current value of anything you want to keep; omitted
optional fields become null. Enum fields accept their names (case-insensitive) or
numeric values. Balances (`currentBalance`, `storeCreditBalance`) are
maintained by invoicing and cannot be set here.

lineId.description: Transfer line id (`lines[].id` of `GET /api/v1/transfers/{id}`). The line must be `InTransit` (or already `Failed`). Example: `911`.

reason.description: Why the line failed (required, 1–500 characters); recorded on the line. Example: `Damaged in transit`.

notes.description: Invoice notes shown to the customer.

paymentLinkUrl.description: Online payment link, if one was generated.

id.description: Line id.

syncId.description: Stable cross-device id.

description.description: Line description.

originalUnitPrice.description: Price per unit before discount, when a discount applied.

discountPercent.description: Discount percentage applied to the line.

discountAmount.description: Discount amount applied to the line.

notes.description: Line notes, if any.

id.description: Payment id.

syncId.description: Stable cross-device id.

paymentMethod.description: Method (e.g. Cash, Card, Check), if recorded.

InvoicePaymentDto.description: A payment recorded against an invoice.

id.description: Numeric id, usable in `/api/v1/invoices/{id}`.

syncId.description: Stable cross-device id; also the pagination cursor.

jobId.description: Job the invoice bills, if any.

salesOrderId.description: Sales order the invoice bills, if any.

description.description: Optional description.

invoiceDate.description: Issue date, ISO-8601 UTC at midnight, e.g. `2026-09-05T00:00:00Z`.

dueDate.description: Due date, ISO-8601 UTC at midnight, e.g. `2026-10-05T00:00:00Z`.

balanceDue.description: Total minus payments and store credit.

isConsolidated.description: True when this invoice consolidates other invoices.

consolidatedIntoInvoiceId.description: Id of the consolidated invoice that absorbed this one, if any.

sentDate.description: When the invoice was first sent, ISO-8601 UTC (e.g. `2026-09-05T14:30:00Z`); null if never sent.

paidDate.description: When the invoice was paid in full, ISO-8601 UTC; null until paid.

updatedAt.description: Last modification time, ISO-8601 UTC; null when never edited. Use with the `updatedSince` filter to poll for changes.

InvoiceSummary.description: Invoice header as listed by `GET /api/v1/invoices`. Timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC (`2026-09-05T14:30:00Z`).

isPrimary.description: True for the barcode printed on labels.

ItemBarcodeDto.description: A barcode attached to an item.

primaryCategoryId.description: The item's primary category (`categoryId` on `GET /api/v1/items/{id}`); null when none. Changed with `PATCH /api/v1/items/{id}`, not here.

assignedCategoryIds.description: Categories assigned to the item by hand (Items page → Categories), e.g. `[4, 7]`; the ones `POST` / `DELETE /api/v1/items/{id}/categories/{categoryId}` change.

categories.description: Every category the item is in: the assigned ones, their parent categories and those its Template Builder gives it; ordered by name.

ItemCategoriesResponse.description:
Body of `GET /api/v1/items/{id}/categories` and of the item-category writes: the item's
primary category, the categories assigned to it by hand and every category it is in.

id.description: Category id, e.g. `4`.

name.description: Category name, e.g. `"Lumber"`.

parentCategoryId.description: Parent category id; null for a top-level category.

isAssigned.description: True when the category is assigned to the item by hand (in `assignedCategoryIds`); false when it comes from an assigned child category or the item's Template Builder.

isTemplateBuilderCategory.description: True when the category was generated by a Template Builder.

ItemCategoryMembershipDto.description: One category an item is in.

properties.description: Every template property by name (includes `Unit Price` and `Cost` when set).

priceTiers.description: Quantity-break pricing, ascending by quantity. Empty when the item has a single price.

parentItemId.description: Id of the parent template for variant children; null otherwise.

minQuantity.description: Smallest quantity at which UnitPrice applies.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit at or above MinQuantity.

properties.description: Every property of the item, including the pricing properties `Cost` and `Unit Price`.

propagated.description:
Writes only (0 on GET): how many inventory units' copies of the property were changed by the
write (a new value flowing to units that were not individually customized, a new item-level
property added to existing units, or the copies removed with a deleted one).

ItemPropertiesResponse.description:
Body of `GET /api/v1/items/{id}/properties` and of every custom-field write: all of an
item's properties (custom fields) with their definitions and current values, ordered by name.

id.description: Property id, e.g. `341`; used by the per-property routes.

name.description: Property name as shown in the app, e.g. `"Color"` (unique per item, case-insensitive).

value.description:
Current value as stored, never null (`""` = no value). Numbers are decimal strings
(`"12.5"`), booleans `"true"`/`"false"`, dates `yyyy-MM-dd`, MultiSelect a
comma-separated list of options (`"Red,Blue"`). A calculated property shows its last computed value.

options.description: Allowed values for `Dropdown` / `MultiSelect`, e.g. `["Red","Blue"]`; empty for other types (and for a list property that has no options yet, which then accepts any value).

isCalculated.description:
True when the value comes from a calculation (a formula authored in the app). Calculated
properties are read-only here: value writes answer `409`.

calculationExpression.description: The calculation's formula as stored (references appear as `{n}` placeholders), or null when not calculated. Informational only.

isItemLevel.description:
True for an item-level property added to this item only (Items page "add property", or
`POST /api/v1/items/{id}/properties`); false for a property that came from the item's
Item Template (template builder), its category or item creation.

isCustomized.description:
True when a template-builder property's value was set on this item and so no longer follows
the Item Template ("Customized" in the app). `POST .../properties/{propertyId}/revert` undoes it.

isPricing.description:
True for `Cost` and `Unit Price`: required on every item and changed through
`PATCH /api/v1/items/{id}` (`cost` / `unitPrice`), never through the custom-field routes (`409`).

ItemPropertyDto.description: One custom field (property) of an item: its definition and the item's current value.

id.description: Numeric id, usable in `/api/v1/items/{id}`.

syncId.description: Stable cross-device id; also the pagination cursor.

name.description: Display name.

description.description: Free-text description, if any.

unitPrice.description: Selling price from the template's `Unit Price` property; null when not priced.

cost.description: Purchase cost from the template's `Cost` property; null when unknown.

onHand.description:
Units on hand across stock locations (job sites excluded). Decimal because items sold
by sub-unit report partial rows; negative when the organization allows overselling.

isMiscItem.description: True for ad-hoc "misc" items that never carry stock.

isParentTemplate.description: True for a grouping template whose children are the stocked variants.

sellByUnits.description: True when the item is sold in sub-units of a parent row.

unitName.description: Name of the sub-unit when SellByUnits is true.

updatedAt.description: UTC last modification time; null when never edited.

preferredVendorId.description:
Id of the vendor this item is normally reordered from (see `GET /api/v1/vendors`); null
when none is set. Set on Item Templates → Edit or with `PATCH /api/v1/items/{id}`. Example: `3`.

preferredVendorName.description: Name of the preferred vendor; null when none is set. Example: `"Ferguson"`.

vendorPartNumber.description: The vendor's own part / catalogue number for this item, max 100 characters; null when unknown. Example: `"PX-12C"`.

ItemSummary.description:
One sellable/stockable item (an `ItemTemplate`) as listed by `GET /api/v1/items`.
Physical rows in inventory are instances of a template; the API exposes templates
because that is what agents price, sell and reorder.

id.description: Unit id, e.g. `5012`; used by `PUT /api/v1/items/{id}/units/{unitId}/properties/{name}`.

syncId.description: Globally unique sync id (GUID). Use it as the `after` pagination cursor.

name.description: The unit's display name (normally the item's name).

locationId.description: Id of the location holding the unit (see `GET /api/v1/locations`); null when it has none.

locationName.description: Name of that location; null when the unit has none.

createdAt.description: UTC creation timestamp (ISO-8601) — when the unit entered stock.

updatedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the unit's last edit or move, including a change to one of its custom-field values; null when never changed.

properties.description: The unit's custom-field values, ordered by name. Includes `Cost` (the unit's own cost) and the pricing copy `Unit Price`, flagged `isPricing`.

ItemUnitDto.description:
One inventory unit (a physical stock row) of an item, as returned by
`GET /api/v1/items/{id}/units`, with its own copy of the item's custom fields.

id.description: The unit's property id, e.g. `88213` (differs from the item's property id).

name.description: Property name, e.g. `"Color"`; the `{name}` of the per-unit PUT.

value.description: The unit's value as stored, never null (`""` = none); formats as on `GET /api/v1/items/{id}/properties`.

isCalculated.description: True when the value comes from a calculation on this unit; such values cannot be set (`409`).

isCustomized.description: True when the value was set on this unit and no longer follows the item's value.

isItemLevel.description: True when the property does not come from the item's Item Template (an item-level property of the item, or one added on this unit).

isPricing.description: True for `Cost` and `Unit Price`, which cannot be set per unit through the API (`409`).

ItemUnitPropertyDto.description: One custom-field value on an inventory unit.

ItemUnitStatus.description: Where an inventory unit stands, derived from its location and transfer state.

id.description: The item (template) id as used by `/api/v1/items/{id}`.

changedFields.description: camelCase names of the fields that changed in this save, any of `name`, `description`, `categoryId`, `isDeleted`, `preferredVendorId`, `vendorPartNumber` (the vendor pair since 2026-09-23), `unitPrice`, `cost`, `properties` (the item's custom fields) and `unitProperties` (custom-field values on its inventory units). Example: `["unitPrice"]`.

changedProperties.description: Names of the item's custom fields added, deleted or edited (value, name, type or options) in this save, both names on a rename; omitted when none (2026-09-23, additive).

changedUnitProperties.description: Names of custom fields whose value changed on one or more of the item's inventory units in this save; omitted when none (2026-09-23, additive).

userId.description: Identity user id of the assignee (matches `/api/v1/users`).

name.description: Display name (first + last, or email when no name is set). Example: `Maria Lopez`.

scheduleGroupId.description: Schedule group (crew) the assignment was made under, or null.

notes.description: Note attached to the assignment, if any.

JobAssigneeDto.description: One staff member assigned to a job.

id.description: Charge id — pass as `chargeId` to `PATCH`/`DELETE /api/v1/jobs/{id}/charges/{chargeId}`. Example: `4210`.

syncId.description: Stable cross-device identifier of the charge.

name.description: Charge name shown on the job and invoice. Example: `Disposal fee`.

description.description: Longer description of the charge, or null when none. Example: `Haul-away of the old unit`.

price.description: Price charged to the customer before discounts, in the organization's currency (e.g. `75.00`).

discountPercent.description: Line discount as a percentage (0–100), applied before the flat discount.

discountAmount.description: Flat discount taken off the charge after the percentage discount, in the organization's currency.

effectivePrice.description: Price after both line discounts, in the organization's currency — the amount that rolls into `customChargesTotal`. Example: `67.50`.

JobCustomChargeDto.description: A custom charge (fee, disposal, permit …) on a job.

id.description: Numeric id used in `/api/v1/jobs/{id}`. Unique within this organization. Example: `1042`.

syncId.description: Stable cross-device identifier (GUID) — also the pagination cursor value. Example: `3f2504e0-4f89-11d3-9a0c-0305e82c3301`.

jobNumber.description: Human-readable job number shown to staff and customers. Example: `J-2026-0042`.

jobType.description: Free-text job category configured by the organization. Example: `Installation`, `Repair`.

status.description:
Workflow status name. One of `Draft`, `InspectionInProgress`, `Estimated`,
`AwaitingOptionSelection`, `Scheduled`, `InProgress`, `Completed`,
`Invoiced`, `Paid`, `Cancelled`, `Outstanding`.

statusName.description: Display label of the status as the organization has customised it (falls back to `status`). Example: `On Site`.

paymentStatus.description: Payment state, independent of workflow status: `Unpaid`, `Partial`, `Paid`, `Overpaid` or `Refunded`.

customerId.description: Id of the customer the job is for (see `/api/v1/customers/{id}`).

customerName.description: Customer display name at read time. Example: `Acme Property Management`.

description.description: Short description of the work. May be null for drafts.

createdAt.description: When the job was created, ISO-8601 UTC. Example: `2026-09-01T14:03:22Z`.

updatedAt.description:
Last modification time, ISO-8601 UTC (creation time when never modified). Use with the
`updatedSince` filter to poll for changes.

scheduledDate.description:
Scheduled start as the organization's local wall-clock time with no UTC offset (the
`date-time` format here is a local time, not RFC 3339 with zone), e.g.
`2026-09-08T08:30:00`. Null when unscheduled.

scheduledDurationMinutes.description: Planned duration in minutes (default 120 when scheduled without an explicit duration). Null when unscheduled.

startDate.description: When work actually started, ISO-8601 UTC. Null until the job is in progress.

completedDate.description: When work was completed, ISO-8601 UTC. Null until completed.

totalPrice.description: Customer price before tax, after the job-level discount, in the organization's currency (decimal, e.g. `1250.00`).

notes.description: Internal notes typed on the job itself (not the timeline). Null when empty.

materialPrice.description: Sum of material lines before job-level discount and tax (decimal currency, e.g. `800.00`).

laborPrice.description: Sum of labor lines before job-level discount and tax (decimal currency).

customChargesTotal.description: Sum of custom charges before job-level discount and tax (decimal currency).

discountPercent.description: Job-level discount as a percentage of every line (0–100), or null when a fixed amount / no discount applies.

discountAmount.description: Job-level fixed discount amount (decimal currency), or null when a percentage / no discount applies.

taxRate.description: Tax rate locked in at creation, as a percentage (e.g. `8.25`).

downPaymentAmount.description: Money collected before invoicing (decimal currency), or null when none.

assignees.description: Staff assigned to the job (requires the Scheduling module to change). Empty when unassigned.

items.description: Material lines (parts/products) on the job, excluding removed lines.

laborItems.description: Labor lines on the job, excluding removed lines.

customCharges.description: Custom charges (fees, disposal, permits …) on the job, excluding removed charges. Edit or remove one with its `id` via `PATCH`/`DELETE /api/v1/jobs/{id}/charges/{chargeId}`.

updates.description: Timeline of notes, progress updates and status changes, oldest first.

warning.description:
Set only on the `POST /api/v1/jobs` response when `publishImmediately` was
requested but the job could not be published yet (it was created as a `Draft`),
e.g. `Not published yet: Cannot finalize estimate. All material items must have a unit price.`.
Always null on `GET`.

JobDetailDto.description:
Full job as returned by `GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}`: everything in
`JobSummaryDto` plus the job site, pricing breakdown, assignees, material
and labor lines and the note/update timeline.

id.description: Line id.

syncId.description: Stable cross-device identifier of the line.

description.description: What the work is. Example: `Replace torsion springs`.

actualHours.description: Hours actually worked (decimal). Zero until logged.

customerRate.description: Hourly rate billed to the customer (decimal currency).

customerTotal.description: Customer price for the line after line discount, before job discount and tax (decimal currency).

technicianId.description: Identity user id of the technician the line is booked to, or null.

status.description: Line state name from the LaborItemStatus enum (e.g. `Planned`, `Scheduled`, `Completed`).

notes.description: Line note, or null when none. Example: `Overtime rate approved by owner`.

JobLaborLineDto.description: A labor line on a job.

id.description: Line id.

syncId.description: Stable cross-device identifier of the line.

itemTemplateName.description: Catalog product name at read time. Example: `Torsion Spring 2in x 32in`.

quantity.description: Quantity ordered for the job (whole units).

deliveredQuantity.description: Quantity already delivered to / used at the site.

unitPrice.description: Customer unit price before line discount (decimal currency).

discountAmount.description: Line discount as a fixed amount (decimal currency).

totalPrice.description: Extended customer price after line discount, before job discount and tax (decimal currency).

status.description: Fulfilment state: `Planned`, `Reserved`, `Used` (delivered) or `Returned`.

notes.description: Line note, or null when none. Example: `Bring the 8-ft ladder`.

JobMaterialLineDto.description: A material (part/product) line on a job.

id.description: Entry id.

syncId.description: Stable cross-device identifier of the entry.

type.description: Kind of entry — JobUpdateType name such as `GeneralNote`, `ProgressUpdate`, `Issue`, `CustomerRequest`, `StatusChange`, `Photo` or `Signature`.

description.description: The note text.

isInternal.description: True when the note is staff-only and must not be shown to the customer.

createdAt.description: When the entry was written, ISO-8601 UTC.

createdByName.description: Display name of the author, when recorded.

oldStatus.description: For status-change entries: the previous status name; otherwise null.

newStatus.description: For status-change entries: the new status name; otherwise null.

attachmentName.description:
For `Photo` / `Signature` entries: the attached image's file name (e.g.
`J-1042-20260929-143015.jpg`); null for entries without an attachment. The image itself is
viewable on the job's page in the web app and is included in the organization data export.

JobNoteDto.description: One entry on a job's timeline (note, progress update, issue, status change…).

id.description: Photo id — the same number as the entry's `id` in the job's `updates`. Use it to fetch or delete the photo. Example: `77`.

syncId.description: Stable cross-device identifier of the photo entry (GUID). Example: `3f2c1b9e-8a41-4c55-9d7e-0b6f3f7a1c20`.

caption.description: Caption shown on the job's timeline; `Photo` when none was given. Up to 2000 characters. Example: `Rust on the bottom panel`.

attachmentName.description: The image's file name, e.g. `J-1042-20260929-143015.jpg`; null when none was recorded.

contentType.description: MIME type of the image: `image/jpeg` or `image/png`.

createdAt.description: When the photo was added, ISO-8601 UTC. Example: `2026-09-29T14:30:15Z`.

createdByName.description: Display name (or email) of the person who added the photo, when recorded. Example: `Maria Lopez`.

JobPhotoDto.description:
A photo on a job (a `Photo` entry of the job's timeline), as returned by
`GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}/photos`. The image itself is at
`GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}/photos/{photoId}/content`.

id.description: Customer address id (see `/api/v1/customers/{id}/locations`).

name.description: Label the customer gave the address. Example: `Main Office`.

JobSiteAddressDto.description: A customer address used as the job site.

id.description: Numeric id used in `/api/v1/jobs/{id}`. Unique within this organization. Example: `1042`.

syncId.description: Stable cross-device identifier (GUID) — also the pagination cursor value. Example: `3f2504e0-4f89-11d3-9a0c-0305e82c3301`.

jobNumber.description: Human-readable job number shown to staff and customers. Example: `J-2026-0042`.

jobType.description: Free-text job category configured by the organization. Example: `Installation`, `Repair`.

status.description:

paymentStatus.description: Payment state, independent of workflow status: `Unpaid`, `Partial`, `Paid`, `Overpaid` or `Refunded`.

customerName.description: Customer display name at read time. Example: `Acme Property Management`.

description.description: Short description of the work. May be null for drafts.

scheduledDurationMinutes.description: Planned duration in minutes (default 120 when scheduled without an explicit duration). Null when unscheduled.

startDate.description: When work actually started, ISO-8601 UTC. Null until the job is in progress.

completedDate.description: When work was completed, ISO-8601 UTC. Null until completed.

totalPrice.description: Customer price before tax, after the job-level discount, in the organization's currency (decimal, e.g. `1250.00`).

JobSummaryDto.description:
One job as returned by `GET /api/v1/jobs`. A compact row for lists, boards and
agents; call `GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}` for assignees, line items and notes.

id.description: Numeric id, usable as a job labor line's `laborRateId`. Example: `4`.

syncId.description: Stable cross-device id; also the pagination cursor.

name.description: Rate name, unique within the organization. Example: `Standard Electrician`.

description.description: Free-text notes about the rate; null when not recorded.

hourlyRate.description: Hourly rate charged to the customer, in the organization's currency (decimal, e.g. `95.00`). `0` for variable-price charges priced per job.

rateType.description: Kind of rate, as a string: one of `Standard`, `Emergency`, `Weekend`, `AfterHours`, `SkillLevel`, `Custom`, `Flat`.

isActive.description: False for a retired rate: kept for history, not offered on new work.

updatedAt.description: UTC last modification time (ISO-8601); null when never edited after creation.

LaborRateDto.description:
A labor rate as returned by `GET /api/v1/labor-rates`: a named hourly charge for a kind of
work. Use the id as a job labor line's `laborRateId` when adding labor to a job.

quantity.description: Whole item rows at the location (not deleted, not in a job site).

id.description: Numeric id, usable in `/api/v1/locations/{id}` and stock writes.

syncId.description: Stable cross-device id; also the pagination cursor.

name.description: Display name, e.g. `Main Warehouse`.

address.description: Street address when recorded; null otherwise.

parentLocationId.description: Id of the containing location; null for a top-level location.

locationType.description: Name of the location's type as configured by the organization, e.g. `Warehouse`, `Vehicle`, `Job Site`.

isJobSite.description: True for a customer job site: stock there is "delivered", never counted as on hand, and cannot be adjusted or moved directly.

isTransportVehicle.description: True for a vehicle (van, truck) that carries stock.

isSystemLocation.description: True for the organization's built-in `No Location` bucket, the default for stock created without a location.

status.description: One of `Active`, `Inactive`, `Maintenance`, `Temporary`.

jobId.description: For a job site: the job it belongs to; null otherwise.

updatedAt.description: UTC last modification time; null when never edited.

LocationSummary.description:
One stock location as listed by `GET /api/v1/locations`: a warehouse, shelf, vehicle or
job site that inventory rows sit in. Use the id as `locationId` in stock adjustments and
moves. Locations form a tree through ParentLocationId.

itemName.description: Item display name. Example: `"1/2\" PEX Coupling"`.

description.description: Item description, if any.

reorderPointId.description: Id of the reorder point that triggered this line (see `GET /api/v1/items/{id}/reorder-points`).

locationId.description: Location the reorder point watches; null = the item's stock at all locations together.

locationName.description: Name of LocationId; null for all locations.

onHand.description: Whole units counted for the reorder point: non-deleted stock rows at LocationId, or everywhere (job sites included) when it is null. Example: `3`.

minimumStock.description: The reorder point: the item is listed while OnHand is strictly below this. Example: `10`.

reorderQuantity.description: Quantity configured to reorder; null when the reorder point has none.

suggestedOrderQuantity.description: Units to order: ReorderQuantity, or twice MinimumStock when unset (the Reorder page's default). Example: `20`.

cost.description: Purchase cost per unit from the item's `Cost` property, in the organization's currency; null when unknown. Example: `0.40`.

vendorId.description: Vendor to order from: the item's preferred vendor, else the vendor of the CSV import that created the item; null when unknown. Example: `3`.

vendorName.description: Name of VendorId; null when unknown.

isPreferredVendor.description: True when VendorId is the item's preferred vendor; false when it came from the import (or there is none).

vendorPartNumber.description: The vendor's part number for the item, if recorded. Example: `"PX-12C"`.

organizationId.description: Numeric id of the key's organization. Example: `5`.

organizationName.description: Display name of the organization. Example: `"Hero Distribution"`.

permissions.description: The permission names this key can exercise (a subset of its creator's). Example: `["ViewJobs","ManageJobs"]`.

MeDto.description:
Identity of the API key presented on the request — used by integration platforms (Zapier, Make) to
test a connection and label it. Reflects the key's organization and the permissions it currently holds.

key.description: Stable module key (e.g. `scheduling`). Use this in code, never Name.

name.description: Display name.

active.description: True when the organization can use the module (included tier or activated).

ModuleSummary.description: One module from the catalog and whether the calling organization has it.

modules.description: Every catalog module with its activation state for this organization.

permissions.description: FlexPermissions names granted to the presented key.

ModulesResponse.description: Capability discovery for an API key: the org's modules and the key's permissions.

fromLocationId.description: Location the units leave (see `GET /api/v1/locations`). Must hold at least `quantity` available units.

toLocationId.description: Location the units arrive at. Omit or null for the organization's "No Location" bucket. Job sites are refused (422) — deliver there through a job or transfer.

quantity.description: Whole units to move, 1..1000. Oldest units at the source move first.

reason.description: Optional note recorded in each moved unit's change history. Max 500 characters.

MoveStockRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/items/{id}/stock/move`: move whole units of an item between two
stock locations. Example: `{ "fromLocationId": 1, "toLocationId": 4, "quantity": 3 }`.
