lastPaymentDate.description: Most recent payment date, ISO-8601 UTC; null when no payment has been recorded.

transferId.description: The order's Pending pick transfer to pick (the `transferId` returned by `/fulfill`). Omit when the order has exactly one Pending transfer. Example: `904`.

lines.description:
Units to pick per transfer line, 1–500 entries. Omit (or send an empty list) to pick every
line in full — the app's "Pick All". Each entry adds `quantity` to the line's picked
count; every entry is checked before anything is written.

PickSalesOrderApiRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/sales-orders/{id}/pick`. Example (pick everything):
`{ "transferId": 904 }`; example (part of one line): `{ "transferId": 904, "lines": [ { "transferItemId": 5120, "quantity": 2 } ] }`.

quantity.description: Units to add to the line's picked count, from 1 up to the units still unpicked on the line (`quantity` − `quantityPicked`; more is 422). Example: `2`.

type.description: URI identifying the problem type (RFC 7807). Currently the generic reference for the HTTP status.

title.description: Short human-readable summary of the status, e.g. "Not Found".

status.description: HTTP status code, repeated from the response line.

detail.description: Explanation specific to this occurrence, e.g. "Job 42 was not found in this organization."

instance.description: Request path the problem occurred on, when known.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 7807 problem detail (application/problem+json). Also carries a traceId string to quote in support requests.

id.description: Numeric id used in `/api/v1/purchase-orders/{id}`. Unique within this organization. Example: `412`.

syncId.description: Stable cross-device identifier (GUID) — also the pagination cursor value. Example: `3c9d1a2b-7e4f-4b6a-8c1d-5e6f7a8b9c0d`.

externalOrderNumber.description: The vendor's own order or confirmation number; null when not recorded. Example: `SO-88213`.

status.description:
Order status name, derived by the app from the order's shipments and received quantities.
One of `Draft` (no shipment yet), `Ordered`, `Shipped`, `PartialShipped`,
`Delivered` (at the receiving location, nothing received yet), `PartialReceived`,
`Received` (every unit received and every shipment delivered), `Cancelled`.

vendorId.description: Id of the vendor record; null for a one-off vendor typed on the order.

vendorName.description: Vendor name (the vendor record's name, else the one-off name on the order). Example: `Acme Supply`. Null when neither is set.

orderDate.description: Order date as entered in the app: the organization's local calendar date, `yyyy-MM-ddT00:00:00` with no UTC offset (the `date-time` format here is a local date, not an RFC 3339 instant; do not convert it between time zones). Example: `2026-09-15T00:00:00`.

expectedDeliveryDate.description: Expected delivery date as entered in the app, same local calendar-date format as `orderDate` (no UTC offset). Example: `2026-09-22T00:00:00`. Null when unknown.

receivedDate.description: When the order became fully `Received`, ISO-8601 UTC; null until then.

totalCost.description: Order total in `currency` as recorded on the order; null when not calculated. Example: `1249.50`.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code of the prices on the order. Example: `USD`.

receivingLocationId.description: Id of the location stock is received at by default (see `/api/v1/locations`). Example: `10`.

lineCount.description: Number of lines on the order. Example: `3`.

quantityOrdered.description: Units ordered across all lines. Example: `40`.

quantityReceived.description: Units received across all lines. Example: `25`.

updatedAt.description: Last modification time (including a receipt), ISO-8601 UTC; null when never modified since creation.

notes.description: Free-text notes on the order. Example: `Deliver to dock 3.` Null when none.

lines.description: The order lines, in the order they were added.

PurchaseOrderDetailDto.description:
One purchase order with its lines, as returned by `GET /api/v1/purchase-orders/{id}`
and by `POST /api/v1/purchase-orders/{id}/receive`.

itemId.description: Item to order (from `GET /api/v1/items`); not a draft or a sub-unit item. Example: `12`.

bundleTemplateId.description: Bundle template to order instead of an item; receiving creates one bundle per unit.

description.description: Line text, up to 500 characters. Defaults to the item or bundle name.

vendorPartNumber.description: The vendor's part number, up to 100 characters. Example: `RMX-122-250`.

quantityOrdered.description: Whole units ordered, at least 1. Example: `24`.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit in the order's currency; becomes each received unit's `Cost`. Optional, not negative. Example: `3.10`.

notes.description: Free-text note on the line.

PurchaseOrderLineApiRequest.description:
One order line: exactly one of `itemId` or `bundleTemplateId`.
Example: `{ "itemId": 12, "quantityOrdered": 24, "unitPrice": 3.10, "vendorPartNumber": "RMX-122" }`.

id.description: Line id — the `lineId` to pass to `POST /api/v1/purchase-orders/{id}/receive`. Example: `1207`.

itemId.description: Item (template) id as used by `/api/v1/items/{id}`; null for a bundle line.

bundleTemplateId.description: Bundle template id for a bundle (kit) line; null for an item line.

name.description: What is ordered: the item or bundle name at read time, else the line description. Example: `Copper 12/2 Romex`.

description.description: Line description as entered on the order. Example: `Copper 12/2 Romex, 250 ft`.

vendorPartNumber.description: The vendor's part number; null when not recorded. Example: `RMX-122-250`.

quantityShipped.description: Units the vendor has shipped, as recorded on the order. Example: `10`.

quantityReceived.description: Units received into stock so far. Example: `6`.

quantityRemaining.description: Units still to receive (`quantityOrdered` minus `quantityReceived`) — the most `receive` accepts for this line. Example: `4`.

unitPrice.description: Unit price in the order's `currency`; becomes the `Cost` property of each received item. Null when not priced. Example: `89.99`.

lineTotal.description: Line total in the order's `currency`; null when not calculated. Example: `899.90`.

shipmentId.description: Id of the shipment the line travels on; null when not assigned to a shipment. Received items on a shipment with a shipping cost get `Shipping Cost` and `Total Cost` properties.

PurchaseOrderLineDto.description: One line of a purchase order: a catalog item or a bundle, with ordered and received quantities.

id.description: Numeric id used in `/api/v1/purchase-orders/{id}`. Unique within this organization. Example: `412`.

syncId.description: Stable cross-device identifier (GUID) — also the pagination cursor value. Example: `3c9d1a2b-7e4f-4b6a-8c1d-5e6f7a8b9c0d`.

externalOrderNumber.description: The vendor's own order or confirmation number; null when not recorded. Example: `SO-88213`.

status.description:
Order status name, derived by the app from the order's shipments and received quantities.
One of `Draft` (no shipment yet), `Ordered`, `Shipped`, `PartialShipped`,
`Delivered` (at the receiving location, nothing received yet), `PartialReceived`,
`Received` (every unit received and every shipment delivered), `Cancelled`.

vendorId.description: Id of the vendor record; null for a one-off vendor typed on the order.

vendorName.description: Vendor name (the vendor record's name, else the one-off name on the order). Example: `Acme Supply`. Null when neither is set.

orderDate.description: Order date as entered in the app: the organization's local calendar date, `yyyy-MM-ddT00:00:00` with no UTC offset (the `date-time` format here is a local date, not an RFC 3339 instant; do not convert it between time zones). Example: `2026-09-15T00:00:00`.

expectedDeliveryDate.description: Expected delivery date as entered in the app, same local calendar-date format as `orderDate` (no UTC offset). Example: `2026-09-22T00:00:00`. Null when unknown.

receivedDate.description: When the order became fully `Received`, ISO-8601 UTC; null until then.

totalCost.description: Order total in `currency` as recorded on the order; null when not calculated. Example: `1249.50`.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code of the prices on the order. Example: `USD`.

receivingLocationId.description: Id of the location stock is received at by default (see `/api/v1/locations`). Example: `10`.

lineCount.description: Number of lines on the order. Example: `3`.

quantityOrdered.description: Units ordered across all lines. Example: `40`.

quantityReceived.description: Units received across all lines. Example: `25`.

updatedAt.description: Last modification time (including a receipt), ISO-8601 UTC; null when never modified since creation.

PurchaseOrderSummaryDto.description:
One purchase order as returned by `GET /api/v1/purchase-orders`: stock ordered from a
vendor, to be received at a location. A flat row for lists and CSV; call
`GET /api/v1/purchase-orders/{id}` for its lines.

PurchaseOrderWebhookData.description: Purchase-order summary carried by `purchase_order.*` events; `previousStatus` is set only on `purchase_order.status_changed`.

lines.description:
Lines to receive (1–200 entries). All are validated before anything is written; the
first problem is reported and nothing is received.

quantity.description:
Whole units received now, 1 to the line's `quantityRemaining` (a line repeated in
the same request counts against the same remaining quantity). Example: `4`.

locationId.description:
Location the stock is created at (see `/api/v1/locations`); must be a location of
this organization that is not deleted. Omit to use the order's `receivingLocationId`.
Example: `11`.

ReceivePurchaseOrderLineApiRequest.description: One line of a receive request.

amount.description: Amount paid. May be 0 when only store credit is applied.

paymentMethod.description: How the customer paid, e.g. `Cash`, `Check`, `CreditCard`, `Other`. Required when `amount` is greater than 0.

applyStoreCredit.description: Apply `storeCreditToApply` of the customer's store credit to the invoice.

storeCreditToApply.description: Store credit amount to apply when `applyStoreCredit` is true (capped at the customer's balance and the balance due). Ignored otherwise.

RecordPaymentApiRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/invoices/{id}/payments`. Records a payment and/or applies store
credit to a finalized invoice — the same rules as the Record Payment dialog: at least one of
`amount` or store credit is required, a payment needs a `paymentMethod`, and the
total may not exceed the balance due (extra money belongs in store credit, not on the invoice).

destinationId.description: Waypoint id or location id, per `destinationType`; ignored for `Destination`. Example: `4`.

reason.description: Optional reason noted on the line, up to 500 characters (the app writes "No reason provided" when omitted). Example: `Side entrance`.

RedirectTransferLineRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/transfers/{id}/lines/{lineId}/redirect`. Example:
`{ "destinationType": "Location", "destinationId": 4, "reason": "Customer asked for the side entrance" }`.

reason.description:
Why the transfer is rejected (required, 1–1000 characters). Stored on the approval and
emailed to the person who requested it. Example: `Van 2 is out of service this week.`

RejectTransferRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/transfers/{id}/reject`. Example:
`{ "reason": "Van 2 is out of service this week." }`.

id.description: Reorder point id. Example: `7`.

itemId.description: Item the reorder point belongs to.

locationId.description: Location it watches; null = the item's stock at all locations together.

locationName.description: Name of LocationId; null for all locations.

minimumStock.description: Low-stock level: below this many units the item is listed by `GET /api/v1/items/low-stock`. Example: `10`.

reorderQuantity.description: Units to reorder; null = twice MinimumStock. Example: `24`.

isActive.description: False when the reorder point is switched off (kept, but never low stock).

createdAt.description: UTC creation time (`0001-01-01T00:00:00Z` for rows made before the API recorded it).

updatedAt.description: UTC last modification time (same caveat as CreatedAt).

ReorderPointDto.description: One reorder point (minimum-stock rule) of an item — a row of the app's Reorder → Thresholds.

start.description: New start as the organization's local wall clock, `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss` with no UTC offset (the `date-time` format here is a local time, not RFC 3339 with zone); a trailing `Z` is converted to local time. Example: `2026-09-08T08:30:00`.

end.description: Optional new end, same local wall-clock format as `start`; when given it must be after `start` and sets the job's duration. Omit to keep the current duration.

note.description: Optional reason recorded on the job.

reason.description: Why the goods come back, 1–500 characters (the return modal requires one); recorded on the order's return history. Example: `Damaged on arrival`.

all.description: `true` = the modal's "Return All": every completed transfer of the order is returned and cancelled. Default `false`.

transferId.description: Quick-return one completed transfer of the order: all its units come back and the transfer is cancelled. Example: `904`.

stockUnitIds.description: Delivered stock units to return (`transfers[].items[].stockUnitId` of `GET …/returnable-items`), up to 1,000. Example: `[4410, 4411]`.

untrackedLines.description: Delivered lines with no stock unit behind them (misc items, shortfalls), returned for value only, up to 500 entries.

overrideLocationId.description: Where units go back to when their source location was deleted: one of `returnLocations[].locationId` of `GET …/returnable-items`. Omit otherwise (units return to their source). Example: `20`.

ReturnSalesOrderItemsApiRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/sales-orders/{id}/returns`: exactly one of `all`,
`transferId` or (`stockUnitIds` and/or `untrackedLines`). Example (selective):
`{ "reason": "Damaged on arrival", "stockUnitIds": [ 4410, 4411 ] }`; example (everything):
`{ "reason": "Order returned", "all": true }`.

quantity.description: Units to return, 1 up to `availableQuantity`. Example: `2`.

ReturnSalesOrderUntrackedLineApiRequest.description: One untracked delivered line to return.

id.description: Custom role id (use it as `customRoleId` / in `customRoleIds` on the user endpoints); null for a built-in role. Example: `4`.

name.description: Role name; for a built-in role this is the value to send as `role`. Example: `"Manager"`.

description.description: What the role is for. Example: `"Manager with inventory and location management access"`.

isBuiltIn.description: True for OrganizationAdmin / Manager / User, which cannot be edited.

rank.description: Hierarchy rank: OrganizationAdmin 3, Manager 2, User 1; custom roles 0 (they add permissions, not rank).

permissions.description: Permissions the role grants, as FlexPermissions names. Example: `["ViewInventory", "ManageJobs"]`.

createdAt.description: UTC creation time (ISO-8601); null for built-in roles.

updatedAt.description: UTC last modification time (ISO-8601); null for built-in roles.

RoleDto.description:
A role accounts can hold, as returned by `/api/v1/roles`: the built-in `OrganizationAdmin`,
`Manager` and `User` (never `SystemAdmin`), then the organization's custom roles.

id.description: Numeric id used in `/api/v1/sales-orders/{id}`. Unique within this organization. Example: `318`.

syncId.description: Stable cross-device identifier (GUID) — also the pagination cursor value. Example: `7b1e2c3d-4f5a-4b6c-9d8e-0f1a2b3c4d5e`.

orderNumber.description: Order number assigned by the app, `SO` + two-digit year + two-digit month + a four-digit sequence per month. Example: `SO26090007`.

status.description:
Order status. One of `Pending` (created, lines can be added, fulfilment not started or
not covering every line), `Picking` (a pick transfer covers every line and items are
being picked), `Packed` (everything picked), `Shipped` (every transfer has shipping
info), `Delivered` (every transfer completed), `Complete` (terminal: marked complete,
or delivered and fully invoiced and paid) and `Cancelled` (terminal). Legacy rows may still say the
deprecated `Confirmed`. Over the API `/fulfill` starts fulfilment and the later
statuses follow from `/pick`, `/complete-pick`, `/ship` and `/deliver`, as in the app.

paymentStatus.description: Payment status: `Pending`, `Partial`, `Paid`, `Overdue`, `Refunded`, `Invoiced` or `Cancelled`. Example: `Pending`. Null on some legacy rows.

fulfillmentStatus.description: Aggregate status of the order's transfers (the earliest one wins): `None` (no transfer yet), `Draft`, `Pending`, `InTransit`, `AtWaypoint`, `InTransitToWaypoint`, `InTransitToDestination`, `Completed`, `Cancelled`, `Failed`. Example: `Pending`.

customerName.description: Customer name at read time. Example: `Acme Plumbing`.

customerPONumber.description: The customer's own purchase-order reference; null when none. Example: `PO-7781`.

orderDate.description: Order date as entered in the app: the organization's local calendar date with no UTC offset (not an instant; do not convert it between time zones). Example: `2026-09-23T00:00:00`.

requestedDeliveryDate.description: Requested delivery date, same organization-local calendar-date format as `orderDate`; null when none. Example: `2026-09-30T00:00:00`.

subTotal.description: Sum of the line totals, in the organization's currency. Example: `1250.00`.

taxRate.description: Tax rate in percent (8.25 = 8.25 %). 0 for a tax-exempt customer. Example: `8.25`.

taxAmount.description: Tax, `subTotal` × `taxRate` / 100, in the organization's currency. Example: `103.13`.

shippingCost.description: Shipping charged on the order, in the organization's currency. Example: `25.00`.

totalAmount.description: Order total, `subTotal` + `taxAmount` + `shippingCost`, in the organization's currency. Example: `1378.13`.

amountPaid.description: Amount paid so far, in the organization's currency. Example: `500.00`.

balanceDue.description: Still owed: `totalAmount` − `amountPaid` − store credit applied, in the organization's currency. Example: `878.13`.

lineCount.description: Number of lines on the order (removed lines excluded). Example: `3`.

updatedAt.description: Last recorded modification (header or line edits, lines added or removed, status change, fulfilment and pick progress, `fulfillmentStatus` change), ISO-8601 UTC; null when never modified since creation. Payments do not move it (`paymentStatus` / `amountPaid` / `balanceDue` can change without it). Example: `2026-09-23T15:12:00Z`.

deliveryAddressId.description: Id of the customer address the order is delivered to; null when none. Example: `77`.

paymentTerms.description: Payment terms text. Example: `Net 30`. Null when none.

notes.description: Free-text notes on the order. Example: `Leave at loading dock.` Null when none.

lines.description: The order lines (removed lines excluded), in the order they were added.

SalesOrderDetailDto.description:
One sales order with its lines, as returned by `GET /api/v1/sales-orders/{id}` and
`POST /api/v1/sales-orders`.

status.description:
Order status after fulfilment started, recalculated from its transfers: `Picking` when
the transfers cover every line, otherwise still `Pending` (some lines had no available
stock; fulfil again once stock arrives). Example: `Picking`.

transferId.description: Id of the pick transfer created (see `/api/v1/transfers/{id}`). Example: `904`.

message.description: Human-readable confirmation, as the app shows it. Example: `Order status updated to Picking`.

id.description: Line id. Example: `1502`.

itemId.description: Catalog item id as used by `/api/v1/items/{id}`; null for a legacy free-text line.

description.description: Line description (the item name when the line was added). Example: `Copper 12/2 Romex`.

unitPrice.description: Unit price, in the organization's currency. Example: `125.00`.

unitCost.description: Unit cost, in the organization's currency; 0 when unknown. Example: `80.00`.

lineTotal.description: Line total, `quantityOrdered` × `unitPrice`, in the organization's currency. Example: `1250.00`.

notes.description: Line notes. Example: `Cut to 25 ft lengths`. Null when none.

SalesOrderLineDto.description: One line of a sales order: a catalog item with ordered, picked and shipped quantities.

lineId.description: The line picked; null for `/lines/pick-all`. Example: `1502`.

itemName.description: The picked item's name; null for `/lines/pick-all`. Example: `Copper 12/2 Romex`.

quantityPicked.description: The line's picked quantity after the call (0 for `/lines/pick-all`). Example: `3`.

quantityOrdered.description: The line's ordered quantity (0 for `/lines/pick-all`). Example: `10`.

orderComplete.description: `/scan`, `/lines/{lineId}/pick`, `/lines/pick-all`: every line of the order is now picked in full. Always `false` for `picked-quantity`. Example: `false`.

linesUpdated.description: `/lines/pick-all`: lines raised to their ordered quantity (0 = all were already picked). Example: `2`.

unitsAdded.description: `/lines/pick-all`: units added across those lines. Example: `7`.

status.description: The order's status after the call (line picks never change it). Example: `Picking`.

message.description: Human-readable confirmation, as the app shows it; null for a single scan / pick. Example: `Picking progress saved`.

SalesOrderLinePickResponse.description: Response of the line-level pick endpoints (`/scan`, `/lines/{lineId}/pick`, `/lines/pick-all`, `/lines/{lineId}/picked-quantity`).

locationId.description: Location id — pass it as `overrideLocationId`. Example: `20`.

name.description: Location name. Example: `Main Warehouse`.

path.description: Full path in the location hierarchy. Example: `Main Warehouse > Aisle 3`.

SalesOrderReturnLocationDto.description: A location units can be returned to.

status.description: The order's status after the return (returns do not change it). Example: `Delivered`.

fulfillmentStatus.description: Aggregate status of the order's transfers after the return (a fully returned transfer is `Cancelled`). Example: `Cancelled`.

message.description: Human-readable confirmation, as the app shows it. Example: `Successfully returned 2 item(s).`

itemsReturned.description: Units returned (stock units restocked plus untracked units by value). Example: `2`.

transfersCancelled.description: Transfers cancelled because every line was returned. Example: `1`.

storeCreditIssued.description: Store credit issued to the customer for an overpayment the return created, in the organization's currency. Example: `250.00`.

overpaymentAmount.description: Overpayment left after that credit (normally 0), in the organization's currency. Example: `0`.

transfers.description: Completed transfers of the order with what is still returnable on each (empty when nothing was delivered).

needsReturnLocation.description: `true` when some source location was deleted: pass `overrideLocationId` (one of `returnLocations`) to return those units. Example: `false`.

returnLocations.description: The company locations units can be returned to when `needsReturnLocation` is true; empty otherwise.

SalesOrderReturnableItemsDto.description: What `GET /api/v1/sales-orders/{id}/returnable-items` returns: the order's delivered goods that can still be returned.

transferId.description: Transfer id (`/api/v1/transfers/{id}`); pass as `transferId` to return it whole. Example: `904`.

sourceLocationId.description: Where the units came from (they return there); null when unknown. Example: `20`.

sourceLocationName.description: Source location name at read time. Example: `Main Warehouse`.

sourceLocationDeleted.description: `true` when the source location was deleted (returns then need `overrideLocationId`). Example: `false`.

destinationLocationName.description: Where the goods were delivered. Example: `Customer: Acme Plumbing - Main Office`.

transferDate.description: When the transfer was created, ISO-8601 UTC. Example: `2026-09-23T14:05:00Z`.

items.description: Delivered stock units still at the customer, one entry per unit.

untrackedLines.description: Delivered lines with no stock unit behind them, returnable for value only.

SalesOrderReturnableTransferDto.description: One completed transfer of the order and its returnable content.

stockUnitId.description: Stock unit id — pass it in `stockUnitIds`. Example: `4410`.

itemId.description: Catalog item (template) id as used by `/api/v1/items/{id}`; null for a unit without one. Example: `5`.

name.description: Item name. Example: `Copper 12/2 Romex`.

transferItemId.description: The transfer line that delivered it. Example: `5120`.

unitPrice.description: Unit price charged on the order line, in the organization's currency (what a return credits before discount). Example: `125.00`.

SalesOrderReturnableUnitDto.description: One delivered stock unit that can be returned.

transferItemId.description: Transfer line id — pass it in `untrackedLines[].transferItemId`. Example: `5121`.

itemId.description: Catalog item (template) id; null for a miscellaneous line. Example: `5`.

name.description: Item name. Example: `Delivery fee`.

availableQuantity.description: Units still returnable (delivered minus already returned). Example: `2`.

unitPrice.description: Unit price, in the organization's currency. Example: `15.00`.

SalesOrderReturnableUntrackedLineDto.description: A delivered line with no stock unit (misc item or shortfall), returnable for value only.

Order status after the step: `Pending`, `Picking`, `Packed`, `Shipped`,
`Delivered`, `Complete` or `Cancelled`. Recalculated from the order's
transfers, so always read it rather than assuming the next status. Example: `Packed`.

fulfillmentStatus.description: Aggregate status of the order's transfers (`None`, `Pending`, `InTransit`, `AtWaypoint`, `Completed`, `Cancelled`…), as `fulfillmentStatus` on the order. Example: `InTransit`.

transferId.description: The transfer the step acted on (resolved when the request did not name one); null for `/complete` and `/cancel`. Example: `904`.

message.description: Human-readable confirmation, as the app shows it. Example: `Transfer status updated to In Transit.`

unitsPicked.description: `/pick`: units marked picked by this call (0 for other steps). Example: `10`.

itemsReturned.description: `/cancel`: delivered units returned to inventory (0 for other steps). Example: `0`.

transfersCancelled.description: `/cancel`: transfers cancelled (0 for other steps). Example: `1`.

SalesOrderStepResponse.description: Response of the sales-order fulfilment steps (`/pick`, `/complete-pick`, `/ship`, `/deliver`, `/complete`, `/cancel`).

id.description: Numeric id used in `/api/v1/sales-orders/{id}`. Unique within this organization. Example: `318`.

syncId.description: Stable cross-device identifier (GUID) — also the pagination cursor value. Example: `7b1e2c3d-4f5a-4b6c-9d8e-0f1a2b3c4d5e`.

orderNumber.description: Order number assigned by the app, `SO` + two-digit year + two-digit month + a four-digit sequence per month. Example: `SO26090007`.

paymentStatus.description: Payment status: `Pending`, `Partial`, `Paid`, `Overdue`, `Refunded`, `Invoiced` or `Cancelled`. Example: `Pending`. Null on some legacy rows.

customerName.description: Customer name at read time. Example: `Acme Plumbing`.

customerPONumber.description: The customer's own purchase-order reference; null when none. Example: `PO-7781`.

orderDate.description: Order date as entered in the app: the organization's local calendar date with no UTC offset (not an instant; do not convert it between time zones). Example: `2026-09-23T00:00:00`.

requestedDeliveryDate.description: Requested delivery date, same organization-local calendar-date format as `orderDate`; null when none. Example: `2026-09-30T00:00:00`.

subTotal.description: Sum of the line totals, in the organization's currency. Example: `1250.00`.

taxRate.description: Tax rate in percent (8.25 = 8.25 %). 0 for a tax-exempt customer. Example: `8.25`.

taxAmount.description: Tax, `subTotal` × `taxRate` / 100, in the organization's currency. Example: `103.13`.

amountPaid.description: Amount paid so far, in the organization's currency. Example: `500.00`.

balanceDue.description: Still owed: `totalAmount` − `amountPaid` − store credit applied, in the organization's currency. Example: `878.13`.

lineCount.description: Number of lines on the order (removed lines excluded). Example: `3`.
