Payments do not move it (`paymentStatus` / `amountPaid` / `balanceDue` can change without it). Example: `2026-09-23T15:12:00Z`.

SalesOrderSummaryDto.description:
One sales order as returned by `GET /api/v1/sales-orders`: goods sold to a customer
out of stock (no job). A flat row for lists and CSV; call
`GET /api/v1/sales-orders/{id}` for its lines.

transferId.description: The order's transfer to act on. Omit when the order has exactly one transfer in the state the step needs (`Pending` for complete-pick, in transit for deliver). Example: `904`.

SalesOrderWebhookData.description: Sales-order summary carried by `sales_order.*` events; `previousStatus` is set only on `sales_order.status_changed`.

barcode.description: The scanned value: a stock unit's barcode or a catalog item's barcode, 1–200 characters. Example: `0012345678905`.
The scanned value, 1–200 characters: an item (unit) barcode or an item template barcode. Example: `0012345678905`.

locationId.description: Optional: only lines whose units are at this location id (lines are grouped by the units' location, as in the app's scan dialog). Omit to match any line. Example: `1`.

ScanTransferBarcodeRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/transfers/{id}/scan`: one scanned barcode = one more unit picked.
Example: `{ "barcode": "0012345678905", "locationId": 1 }`.

name.description: Display name. Example: `Maria Lopez`.

groupId.description: Crew the assignment falls under (explicit, or the user's primary group), or null.

groupOrder.description: Crew sort order (lower first; `2147483647` when the user has no crew).

ScheduleEventAssigneeDto.description: An assignee on a schedule event.

status.description: Workflow status name (see `JobSummaryDto.Status` for the list).

description.description: Job description, empty string when none.

scheduledTime.description: Start time formatted for display. Example: `8:30 AM`.

assignees.description: Assigned staff, ordered by crew then name.

assigneeNames.description: Comma-separated assignee names for one-line display. Empty when unassigned.

groupIds.description: Distinct schedule group (crew) ids of the assignees.

groupColor.description: Hex colour of the first assignee's crew, used as the event accent; null when no crew colour applies.

id.description: Job id — fetch details with `GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}`.

title.description: Event title: job number and customer, plus the description on a second line when present. Example: `J-2026-0042 - Acme Property`.

start.description: Start as the organization's local wall-clock time, `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss` with no zone suffix. Example: `2026-09-08T08:30:00`.

url.description: Relative API path of the job. Example: `/api/v1/jobs/1042`.

backgroundColor.description: Hex colour for the event body, derived from the job status. Example: `#28a745`.

borderColor.description: Hex colour for the event border (currently equal to `backgroundColor`).

displayTime.description: Start time formatted for display. Example: `8:30 AM`.

ScheduleEventDto.description:
One scheduled job as a calendar event (`GET /api/v1/schedule`). Same shape as the
feed the web calendar consumes (`Jobs/GetCalendarEvents`) so a FullCalendar-style
client can render it directly.

id.description: Numeric id of the group. Stable within this organization.

syncId.description: Globally unique sync id (GUID). Use it as the `after` pagination cursor.

name.description: Group name, e.g. `"Install Crew A"`.

description.description: Optional description shown on the dispatch board.

colorHex.description: Hex colour used for calendar / board rendering, e.g. `"#2e7d32"`; null when unset.

parentGroupId.description: Id of the parent group (e.g. the division a crew belongs to); null for top-level groups.

parentGroupName.description: Name of the parent group; null for top-level groups.

displayOrder.description:
Sort position among siblings (ascending). Pages are returned in id order, so sort
by this client-side when rendering a board.

members.description: Members of this group, leads first. Only active users are listed.

updatedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the last edit; null when never edited.

userId.description: User id (string GUID) — matches `id` from `GET /api/v1/users` and job assignee ids.

isLead.description: True for the crew lead / foreman of this group.

ScheduleGroupMemberDto.description: A user's membership in a schedule group.

isLead.description:
True makes the user a crew lead / foreman of this group (listed first), false a regular member.
Omit to keep the current flag (a newly added member is not a lead).

ScheduleGroupMemberWriteApiRequest.description: Body of `PUT /api/v1/schedule-groups/{id}/members/{userId}`. May be empty. Example: `{ "isLead": true }`.

userIds.description: User ids (string GUIDs, from `GET /api/v1/users`) of every member, each an active user of this organization; `[]` removes everyone. At most 500.

leadIds.description: The crew leads / foremen among `userIds` (each must also be in `userIds`); omitted or `[]` = no leads.

ScheduleGroupMembersApiRequest.description:
Body of `PUT /api/v1/schedule-groups/{id}/members`: the group's complete membership.
Example: `{ "userIds": ["3f2a…", "9b1c…"], "leadIds": ["3f2a…"] }`.

parentGroupId.description: The parent whose children were reordered; null for the top level.

items.description: The groups under that parent, in the new `displayOrder` (0, 1, 2, …).

ScheduleGroupOrderResponse.description: Body of `POST /api/v1/schedule-groups/reorder`: the reordered siblings in their new order.

parentGroupId.description: Parent whose child groups are reordered; omit or `0` for the top-level groups.

ids.description: Every group id under that parent exactly once, first to last (ids from `GET /api/v1/schedule-groups?parentGroupId=…`); at most 500.

ScheduleGroupReorderApiRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/schedule-groups/reorder`: the new order of every group under one
parent. Example: `{ "parentGroupId": 3, "ids": [9, 7, 8] }`.

name.description: Group name, 1–100 characters. Required on create; cannot be cleared. Example: `"Install Crew A"`.

description.description: Optional description shown on the dispatch board, up to 500 characters; `""` clears it.

colorHex.description: Colour for calendar / board rendering as 6-digit hex, e.g. `"#2e7d32"` (the `#` is optional; stored lower-case); `""` clears it.

parentGroupId.description:
Id of the parent group (e.g. the division a crew belongs to); `0` makes the group top-level.
Omit on PATCH to keep the current parent (on create, omitted = top-level). A moved group is
placed last among its new siblings; a group cannot be moved under itself or its own descendants.

ScheduleGroupWriteApiRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/schedule-groups` (`name` required) and
`PATCH /api/v1/schedule-groups/{id}` (only the fields sent change; `""` clears
`description` / `colorHex`). Example:
`{ "name": "Install Crew A", "colorHex": "#2e7d32", "parentGroupId": 3 }`.

value.description: New value, at most 4000 characters, in the property's format (see `value` on GET); `""` or null clears it.

SetItemPropertyValueApiRequest.description:
Body of `PUT /api/v1/items/{id}/properties/{propertyId}/value`: replace one custom-field
value. Example: `{ "value": "Red" }`.

values.description:
Property name (case-insensitive, as `name` on GET) → new value (string; `""` or
null clears it). 1-100 entries. Values are checked against the property's
`dataType` and `options` (see `value` on GET for the formats).

SetItemPropertyValuesApiRequest.description:
Body of `PATCH /api/v1/items/{id}/properties`: set several custom-field values at once, by
property name. All or nothing — one refused value changes nothing. Example:
`{ "values": { "Color": "Red", "Length": "12" } }`.

value.description: New value, at most 4000 characters, in the property's format (Number `"12.5"`, Boolean `"true"`/`"false"`, Date `yyyy-MM-dd`, Dropdown one option, MultiSelect comma-separated options); `""` or null clears it.

SetItemUnitPropertyApiRequest.description:
Body of `PUT /api/v1/items/{id}/units/{unitId}/properties/{name}`: the unit's new value.
Example: `{ "value": "Blue" }`.

statusId.description: Target status definition id (one of the org's statuses).

statusKey.description: Target status by name — a status definition name (case-insensitive) or a system status key such as `InProgress`, `Completed`.

note.description: Optional note appended to the status-change history entry.

SetJobStatusRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/status`. Exactly one of `statusId` / `statusKey` is required.

locationId.description: Location to watch (see `GET /api/v1/locations`); omit or null for the item's stock at all locations together. Unknown or another organization's id → 422. Example: `3`.

minimumStock.description: Required. Low-stock level, a whole number 0 or more: the item is low while fewer units than this are on hand. Example: `10`.

reorderQuantity.description: Units to reorder, 0 or more; omit or null for the default of twice `minimumStock`. Example: `24`.

isActive.description: Whether the reorder point is on; omit for `true`. `false` keeps it but stops it listing the item as low stock.

SetReorderPointApiRequest.description:
Body of `PUT /api/v1/items/{id}/reorder-points`: create or update the item's reorder
point for one location (or for all locations together when `locationId` is omitted).
Example: `{ "locationId": 3, "minimumStock": 10, "reorderQuantity": 24 }`.

quantityPicked.description: The line's new picked quantity, 0–1,000,000 (more than ordered is allowed, as in the app). Lower than now = unpick. Example: `3`.

transferId.description: The order's in-transit transfer being shipped. Omit when the order has exactly one transfer in transit. Example: `904`.

withoutTracking.description:
`true` = the app's "Ship without tracking": no shipment record, the transfer is only
            flagged shipped so it can be delivered. Then `carrier`, `trackingNumber` and the
            other shipment fields must be omitted. Default `false`.

carrier.description: Carrier name, up to 100 characters. Example: `UPS`.

trackingNumber.description: Carrier tracking number, up to 100 characters. Example: `1Z999AA10123456784`.

shippingMethod.description: Shipping method / service level, up to 50 characters. Example: `Ground`.

shipDate.description: Ship date as ISO-8601 (stored as sent); omit for now (UTC). Example: `2026-09-23T15:00:00Z`.

estimatedDeliveryDate.description: Estimated delivery date as ISO-8601 (stored as sent). Example: `2026-09-26`.

weight.description: Package weight, 0–1,000,000, in whatever unit the organization uses (the app does not fix one). Example: `12.5`.

notes.description: Free-text shipment notes. Example: `2 boxes`.

destinationId.description: Waypoint id or location id, per `destinationType`; ignored for `Destination`. Example: `4`.

SkipTransferWaypointRequest.description:
Optional body of `POST /api/v1/transfers/{id}/waypoints/{waypointId}/skip`: where the lines
still assigned to the skipped waypoint go instead. Required (both fields) when it has such lines.
Example: `{ "destinationType": "Destination" }`.

description.description: What is being billed.

unitOfMeasure.description: Unit of measure label (e.g. `ea`, `hr`), if any.

StandaloneInvoiceLineApiRequest.description: One line of a standalone invoice.

locationId.description: `Adjust` only: the stock location adjusted. Omit or null for the organization's "No Location" bucket.

delta.description: `Adjust` only: whole units to add (positive) or remove (negative), never zero, -1000..1000. Example: `-2`.

fromLocationId.description: `Move` only: location the units leave. Required for a move.

toLocationId.description: `Move` only: location the units arrive at. Omit or null for "No Location".

quantity.description: `Move` only: whole units to move, 1..1000. Example: `3`.

reason.description: Optional reason recorded in each affected unit's change history. Max 500 characters.

StockBatchEntry.description: One operation of a stock batch: an adjustment (same rules as `/items/{id}/stock/adjust`) or a move (same rules as `/items/{id}/stock/move`).

operations.description: 1..100 operations, applied in the order given. At most 1000 units in total across the batch.

StockBatchRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/items/stock/batch`: several adjustments and moves applied in order,
all or nothing. Example:
<c>{ "operations": [ { "action": "Adjust", "itemId": 12, "locationId": 3, "delta": 10, "reason": "Delivery" },
{ "action": "Move", "itemId": 12, "fromLocationId": 3, "toLocationId": 4, "quantity": 2 } ] }</c>.

results.description: Per operation: the same shape as a single adjust/move response, with the item's stock after the whole batch.

StockBatchResponse.description: Result of `POST /api/v1/items/stock/batch`: one entry per operation, in request order.

message.description: Human-readable confirmation, e.g. `Moved 3 x 'Widget' from 'Main' to 'Van 2'.`

units.description: Whole units added, removed or moved (always positive).

locationId.description: For an adjustment: the location adjusted. For a move: the source location.

destinationLocationId.description: For a move: the destination location; null for an adjustment.

destinationLocationName.description: Name of DestinationLocationId; null for an adjustment.

StockChangeResponse.description: Result of a stock adjustment or move, with the item's stock position after the change.

itemId.description: The item (template) id as used by `/api/v1/items/{id}`.

locationId.description: Location the threshold applies to; null when it is organization-wide.

onHand.description: Total on hand; same semantics as `onHand`.

byLocation.description: Per-location breakdown of physical rows. Sums to the row count, which may differ from OnHand for oversold or sub-unit items.

id.description: Numeric id used in `/api/v1/transfers/{id}`. Unique within this organization. Example: `318`.

syncId.description: Stable cross-device identifier (GUID) — also the pagination cursor value. Example: `0b8f4c1e-6f1a-4a5e-9d7c-2f3e4a5b6c7d`.

status.description:
Transfer status name. One of `Draft`, `Pending` (created, stock reserved, not yet
picked up), `InTransit`, `AtWaypoint`, `InTransitToWaypoint`,
`InTransitToDestination`, `Completed` (delivered), `Cancelled`, `Failed`.

notes.description: Free-text notes recorded on the transfer. Example: `Transfer for Job J-2026-0042`. Null when none.

jobId.description: Id of the job this transfer supplies (see `/api/v1/jobs/{id}`); null for a standalone or sales-order transfer.

jobNumber.description: Job number of `jobId` at read time. Example: `J-2026-0042`. Null when there is no job.

salesOrderId.description: Id of the sales order this transfer fulfils; null otherwise.

isJobTransfer.description: True for a transfer created for a job (materials to its job site, or a direct / counter sale). Standalone transfers (both flags false) are the ones `pick` / `start` / `complete` / `fail` accept; job-site and standalone transfers can be cancelled with `POST /api/v1/transfers/{id}/cancel`.

isSalesOrderTransfer.description: True for a transfer that fulfils a sales order.

sourceLocationId.description: Id of the location the stock leaves (see `/api/v1/locations/{id}`); null when the lines come from several locations or from no location.

sourceLocationName.description: Name of `sourceLocationId`. Example: `Main Warehouse`. Null when there is none.

destinationLocationId.description: Id of the location the stock goes to — for a job-site transfer, the job's site location; null for a de-listing.

destinationLocationName.description: Name of `destinationLocationId`. Example: `Job Site - J-2026-0042`. Null when there is none.

requiresApproval.description: True when the transfer's value exceeded the organization's approval threshold when it was created. Job-site transfers never require approval.

approvalStatus.description: State of the transfer's approval: `Pending` (awaiting `POST /api/v1/transfers/{id}/approve` or `/reject`), `Approved` or `Rejected`; null when the transfer never needed approval.

lineCount.description: Number of item lines on the transfer. Example: `4`.

transferDate.description: When the transfer was initiated, ISO-8601 UTC. Example: `2026-09-23T14:05:00Z`.

initiatedById.description: Identity user id of the person who created the transfer (for an API/MCP-created transfer, the key's creator); null when unknown on this server.

completedById.description: Identity user id of the person who completed (received) the transfer; null until it is completed.

updatedAt.description: Last modification time, ISO-8601 UTC; null when never modified since creation.

rejectionReason.description: Why the transfer's approval was rejected (from `POST /api/v1/transfers/{id}/reject` or the app); null otherwise.

lines.description: The item lines, in the order they were added.

currentWaypointId.description: Id of the waypoint the transfer is heading to or stopped at (`waypoints[].id`); null when it has no waypoints or is heading to its final destination.

waypoints.description: Intermediate stops on the way to the destination, in route order (empty for a direct transfer). Worked with `POST /api/v1/transfers/{id}/waypoints/{waypointId}/arrive|deliver|depart|skip` while the transfer is in transit.

TransferDetailDto.description:
One transfer with its item lines, as returned by `GET /api/v1/transfers/{id}` and by
`POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/transfer`.

id.description: Numeric line id. Example: `1207`.

itemId.description: Item (template) id as used by `/api/v1/items/{id}`; null for a line that carries no catalogue item.

itemName.description: Item name at read time (falls back to the line's notes for a miscellaneous line). Example: `Copper 12/2 Romex`.

quantityPicked.description: Units picked (scanned) so far; null or `0` before picking starts.

quantityDelivered.description: Units delivered to the destination; null until delivery.

quantityReturned.description: Units returned to the source after a failed delivery. Example: `0`.

status.description: Line status name. One of `Pending`, `InTransit`, `Delivered`, `Failed`, `Returned`.

jobItemId.description: Id of the job material line this transfer line supplies (see the `items` of `/api/v1/jobs/{id}`); null when not tied to a job line.

destinationLocationId.description: Per-line destination location id when it differs from the transfer's; null otherwise.

destinationWaypointId.description: Waypoint (`waypoints[].id`) where this line is dropped off instead of the final destination; null when it goes to the destination.

notes.description: Free-text notes on the line. Example: `Stock shortfall: Copper 12/2 Romex`. Null when none.

TransferLineDto.description: One item line of a transfer.

quantity.description: Whole units to pick (at most what is left to pick) or to unpick (at most what is picked), 1–1000; null = all. Example: `2`.

TransferLinePickRequest.description:
Optional body of `POST /api/v1/transfers/{id}/lines/{lineId}/pick` and `…/unpick`.
Example: `{ "quantity": 2 }`. Omit the body (or `quantity`) to pick the rest of the
line / clear all of its picks.

id.description: Numeric id used in `/api/v1/transfers/{id}`. Unique within this organization. Example: `318`.

syncId.description: Stable cross-device identifier (GUID) — also the pagination cursor value. Example: `0b8f4c1e-6f1a-4a5e-9d7c-2f3e4a5b6c7d`.

status.description:
Transfer status name. One of `Draft`, `Pending` (created, stock reserved, not yet
picked up), `InTransit`, `AtWaypoint`, `InTransitToWaypoint`,
`InTransitToDestination`, `Completed` (delivered), `Cancelled`, `Failed`.

notes.description: Free-text notes recorded on the transfer. Example: `Transfer for Job J-2026-0042`. Null when none.

jobId.description: Id of the job this transfer supplies (see `/api/v1/jobs/{id}`); null for a standalone or sales-order transfer.

jobNumber.description: Job number of `jobId` at read time. Example: `J-2026-0042`. Null when there is no job.

salesOrderId.description: Id of the sales order this transfer fulfils; null otherwise.

isJobTransfer.description: True for a transfer created for a job (materials to its job site, or a direct / counter sale). Standalone transfers (both flags false) are the ones `pick` / `start` / `complete` / `fail` accept; job-site and standalone transfers can be cancelled with `POST /api/v1/transfers/{id}/cancel`.

isSalesOrderTransfer.description: True for a transfer that fulfils a sales order.

sourceLocationId.description: Id of the location the stock leaves (see `/api/v1/locations/{id}`); null when the lines come from several locations or from no location.

sourceLocationName.description: Name of `sourceLocationId`. Example: `Main Warehouse`. Null when there is none.

destinationLocationId.description: Id of the location the stock goes to — for a job-site transfer, the job's site location; null for a de-listing.

destinationLocationName.description: Name of `destinationLocationId`. Example: `Job Site - J-2026-0042`. Null when there is none.

requiresApproval.description: True when the transfer's value exceeded the organization's approval threshold when it was created. Job-site transfers never require approval.

approvalStatus.description: State of the transfer's approval: `Pending` (awaiting `POST /api/v1/transfers/{id}/approve` or `/reject`), `Approved` or `Rejected`; null when the transfer never needed approval.

lineCount.description: Number of item lines on the transfer. Example: `4`.

transferDate.description: When the transfer was initiated, ISO-8601 UTC. Example: `2026-09-23T14:05:00Z`.

initiatedById.description: Identity user id of the person who created the transfer (for an API/MCP-created transfer, the key's creator); null when unknown on this server.

completedById.description: Identity user id of the person who completed (received) the transfer; null until it is completed.

updatedAt.description: Last modification time, ISO-8601 UTC; null when never modified since creation.

TransferSummaryDto.description:
One inventory transfer as returned by `GET /api/v1/transfers`: stock moving from a
location to another location or to a job site. A compact row for lists and CSV; call
`GET /api/v1/transfers/{id}` for its item lines.

id.description: Numeric waypoint id, used in `/api/v1/transfers/{id}/waypoints/{waypointId}/…`. Example: `41`.

order.description: Position on the route, 1 = first stop. Example: `1`.

locationId.description: Id of the stop's location (see `/api/v1/locations/{id}`). Example: `4`.

locationName.description: Name of `locationId`. Example: `Van 2`. Null when the location was deleted.

status.description: Waypoint status name: `Pending` (not reached), `Arrived`, `Departed`, `Skipped` or `Cancelled`.

estimatedArrivalTime.description: Planned arrival, ISO-8601 UTC; null when not planned.

actualArrivalTime.description: When the transfer arrived, ISO-8601 UTC; null until then.

departureTime.description: When the transfer left, ISO-8601 UTC; null until then.

notes.description: Free-text notes on the stop (e.g. why it was skipped). Null when none.

TransferWaypointDto.description: One waypoint (intermediate stop) of a transfer.

isJobTransfer.description: True for a transfer created by a job (materials to a job site, direct or counter sale).

lines.description: Item lines: template id, quantity and delivered quantity.

TransferWebhookData.description: Transfer summary carried by `transfer.created`, `transfer.completed` and `transfer.cancelled`; `completedAt` is set only when `status` is `Completed`.

name.description: New name, 1-100 characters (trimmed), unique among the categories with the same parent (case-insensitive).

description.description: New description, at most 2000 characters; `""` clears it.

parentCategoryId.description: New parent category id; `0` moves the category to the top level. The parent may not be the category itself or one of its descendants (no cycles), a system or a Template Builder-generated category.

UpdateCategoryApiRequest.description:
Body of `PATCH /api/v1/categories/{id}`: omitted (or null) fields are unchanged; at least
one is required. Example: `{ "name": "Softwood", "parentCategoryId": 0 }` renames the
category and moves it to the top level.

name.description: New name, 1-100 characters, unique in the category (case-insensitive); `Cost` / `Unit Price` are reserved. Items already carrying the old name keep it.

defaultValue.description: New default value in the property's format, at most 4000 characters; `""` clears it.

options.description: Full replacement option list for a `Dropdown` / `MultiSelect` property (same rules as on create); `[]` clears it.

isRequired.description: Marks the property required (true) or optional (false) in the app.

UpdateCategoryPropertyApiRequest.description:
Body of `PATCH /api/v1/categories/{id}/properties/{propertyId}`: omitted (or null) fields
are unchanged; at least one is required. Example: `{ "defaultValue": "Oak", "displayOrder": 2 }`.

invoiceNumber.description: New invoice number shown to the customer (e.g. `INV-1042`). Omit to leave unchanged; blank is rejected.

invoiceDate.description: New issue date (ISO-8601; the date part is used). Omit to leave unchanged.

dueDate.description: New due date (ISO-8601; the date part is used). Omit to leave unchanged.

taxRate.description: New tax rate as a percentage, 0–100 (e.g. `8.25`). Omit to leave unchanged.

terms.description: New payment terms printed on the invoice (e.g. `Due on Receipt`). Omit to leave unchanged; empty string clears it.

notes.description: New customer-facing notes printed on the invoice. Omit to leave unchanged; empty string clears it.

paymentInstructions.description: New payment instructions printed on the invoice. Omit to leave unchanged; empty string clears it.

UpdateInvoiceDraftApiRequest.description: Body of `PATCH /api/v1/invoices/{id}`: a partial edit of a draft invoice's header. Only the fields you send change; omitted fields are left as they are. Totals are not editable here — the subtotal comes from the job, so recompute it with `POST /api/v1/invoices/{id}/refresh-from-job` after the job's lines change.

name.description: New name, 1-100 characters; omit to keep. Whitespace-only → 422. Renaming also renames every inventory unit of the item.

description.description: New description, max 2000 characters; omit to keep. Send `""` (or whitespace only) to clear it.

categoryId.description: New primary category id; omit to keep. Changing it copies the category's properties onto the item. Unknown or another organization's id → 422.

unitPrice.description: New selling price, 0 or more; omit to keep. Written to the item and its future stock only — existing units keep their own pricing.

cost.description: New purchase cost, 0 or more; omit to keep. Written to the item and its future stock only.

preferredVendorId.description:
New preferred vendor id (from `GET /api/v1/vendors`; must be an active vendor of the
organization, 422 otherwise); omit to keep, send `0` to remove the link. Like
`description` it is edited on the Item Templates page, so it requires `ManageTemplates`. Example: `3`.

vendorPartNumber.description:
New vendor part number, max 100 characters; omit to keep, send `""` to clear it.
Requires `ManageTemplates` (edited on the Item Templates page). Example: `"PX-12C"`.

hasAnyField.description: True when at least one field was supplied.

hasTemplatePageField.description: True when a field only the Item Templates page edits (`ManageTemplates`) was supplied.

UpdateItemApiRequest.description:
Body of `PATCH /api/v1/items/{id}`: change some of an item's name, description,
category, selling price, cost, preferred vendor or vendor part number. Partial update: a field that is omitted (or sent as
`null`) is left unchanged, so send only what should change. At least one field is
required. Example: `{ "unitPrice": 1.35 }` or `{ "name": "PEX Coupling 1/2\"", "categoryId": 7 }`.

name.description: New name, 1-100 characters, unique on the item (case-insensitive); `Cost` / `Unit Price` are reserved.

options.description: Full replacement option list for a `Dropdown` / `MultiSelect` property (at most 200 options, each 1-200 characters, no commas, no duplicates); `[]` clears it. Existing values are not re-checked.

UpdateItemPropertyApiRequest.description:
Body of `PATCH /api/v1/items/{id}/properties/{propertyId}`: change a property's
definition. Omitted (or null) fields are unchanged; at least one is required. Example:
`{ "dataType": "Dropdown", "options": ["Red", "Blue"] }`.

jobType.description: New job type, e.g. `Installation` or `Service`. Omit to leave unchanged.

description.description: New job description. Omit to leave unchanged.

notes.description: New internal notes on the job. Omit to leave unchanged.

scheduledDate.description: New scheduled start (ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. `2026-10-01T09:00:00Z`). Omit to leave unchanged.

customerId.description: Reassign the job to another customer of your organization (customer id from `GET /api/v1/customers`). Omit to leave unchanged.

customerAddressId.description: Set the service address; it must be one of that customer's addresses. Omit to leave unchanged.

UpdateJobApiRequest.description: Body of `PATCH /api/v1/jobs/{id}`: a partial edit of a job's core fields. Only the fields you send change; omitted fields are left as they are.

name.description: New charge name, ≤ 200 characters. Omit to leave unchanged.

price.description: New price, ≥ 0. Omit to leave unchanged.

description.description: New description. Omit to leave unchanged; send an empty string to clear it. ≤ 500 characters.

UpdateJobChargeApiRequest.description: Body of `PATCH /api/v1/jobs/{id}/charges/{chargeId}`: partial edit of a custom charge. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

quantity.description: New quantity, ≥ 1. Only Planned lines (or counter-sales lines) change; can't drop below what was already delivered. Omit to leave unchanged.

unitPrice.description: New unit price, ≥ 0, kept as a manual override unless it equals the resolved price. Omit to leave unchanged; set `clearPriceOverride` to revert to the tier/base price instead.

clearPriceOverride.description: Revert the line to its tier/base-resolved price (clears any manual override). Takes precedence over `unitPrice`. Default `false`.

notes.description: New line note. Omit to leave unchanged; send an empty string to clear it. ≤ 500 characters.

UpdateJobItemApiRequest.description: Body of `PATCH /api/v1/jobs/{id}/items/{itemId}`: partial edit of a material line. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

laborRateId.description: New labor rate id (must belong to your organization). Changing it resets the customer rate and clears any per-job price. Omit to leave unchanged.

estimatedHours.description: New estimated hours, ≥ 0. Omit to leave unchanged.

actualHours.description: New actual hours, ≥ 0. A value > 0 marks the line completed; 0 reverts it to planned. Omit to leave unchanged.

notes.description: New line note. Omit to leave unchanged; send an empty string to clear it. ≤ 500 characters.

UpdateJobLaborApiRequest.description: Body of `PATCH /api/v1/jobs/{id}/labor/{laborId}`: partial edit of a labor line. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

orderNumber.description: New order number, 1–50 characters after trimming (blank is 422). Example: `SO26090007-B`.

customerPONumber.description: The customer's purchase-order reference, up to 100 characters; `""` clears it. Example: `PO-7781`.

paymentTerms.description: Payment terms: one of `Due on Receipt`, `Net 15`, `Net 30`, `Net 45`, `Net 60`, `COD`, `Prepaid` (the Details page's list; anything else is 422); `""` clears them. Example: `Net 30`.

requestedDeliveryDate.description: Requested delivery date, an organization-local calendar date (`yyyy-MM-dd`, no UTC offset). Example: `2026-09-30`.

clearRequestedDeliveryDate.description: `true` clears the requested delivery date; then omit `requestedDeliveryDate`. Default `false`.

notes.description: Free-text notes on the order, stored as sent; `""` clears them. Example: `Leave at loading dock.`

taxRate.description: Tax rate in percent, 0–100 (8.25 = 8.25 %); must stay 0 for a tax-exempt customer (422). Recomputes `taxAmount` and `totalAmount`. Example: `8.25`.

shippingCost.description: Shipping charged on the order, in the organization's currency, 0–1,000,000,000. Recomputes `totalAmount`; draft invoices get a matching "Shipping & Handling" line. Example: `25.00`.

UpdateSalesOrderApiRequest.description:
Body of `PATCH /api/v1/sales-orders/{id}`: the header fields the app's Details page edits
inline. Omitted (or null) members are left unchanged; send `""` to clear an optional text
field. Example: `{ "shippingCost": 25.00, "paymentTerms": "Net 30" }`.

unitPrice.description: New unit price in the organization's currency, 0–1,000,000,000; the line total and the order totals are recomputed. Omit to keep. Example: `119.50`.

unitCost.description: New unit cost in the organization's currency, 0–1,000,000,000. Omit to keep. Example: `80.00`.

UpdateSalesOrderLineApiRequest.description: Body of `PATCH /api/v1/sales-orders/{id}/lines/{lineId}`: the Details page's inline price edit. Example: `{ "unitPrice": 119.50 }`.

quantity.description: New number of units, 1 up to the line's current `quantity` (a line can only shrink; the other units are released). Example: `2`.

UpdateTransferLineRequest.description:
Body of `PATCH /api/v1/transfers/{id}/lines/{lineId}`: reduce the units a line moves.
Example: `{ "quantity": 2 }`.

isActive.description: `false` deactivates the account, `true` reactivates it (same as the deactivate / reactivate endpoints).

customRoleIds.description: The complete set of custom role ids the account should hold; `[]` removes all. Example: `[4, 7]`.

UpdateUserApiRequest.description:
Body of `PATCH /api/v1/users/{id}`; only the fields sent change. Example:
`{ "role": "Manager", "customRoleIds": [4] }`.

id.description: User id (string GUID). Example: `"8f0c3c1e-2b6d-4c55-9a51-0d3f3c1b7e21"`.

displayName.description: Display name, e.g. `"Sam Carter"`; falls back to the e-mail address when no name is recorded.

isActive.description: False when the account is deactivated (it cannot sign in and holds no seat).

role.description:
Highest standard role the account holds — `OrganizationAdmin`, `Manager` or `User`
(`SystemAdmin` for platform staff); null when it holds only custom roles.

customRoleIds.description: Ids of the custom roles the account holds (see `/api/v1/roles`). Empty when none.

permissions.description: Effective permissions from all of the account's roles, in catalog order. Example: `["ViewInventory", "ViewJobs"]`.

UserDetailDto.description:
An account of the calling organization, as returned by the user-administration endpoints
(`GET /api/v1/users/{id}`, `POST /api/v1/users`, `PATCH /api/v1/users/{id}`).
Never carries a password, hash or security stamp.

email.description: The new account's e-mail address. Example: `"sam@example.com"`.

message.description: What happened. Example: `"User sam@example.com created on server. They will appear locally after the next sync."`

UserPendingDto.description:
`202` body of `POST /api/v1/users` when the sync server created the account but this host has
            not received it yet; it appears (and `GET /api/v1/users/{id}` finds it) after the next sync.

id.description: User id (string GUID). Use it as an assignee id when scheduling jobs.

displayName.description: Display name, e.g. `"Sam Carter"`; falls back to the e-mail address when no name is recorded.

email.description:
Login e-mail address, e.g. `sam@example.com`. Only present for callers whose key holds
`ManageUsers`; it is null for a ViewJobs-only (scheduling) key, and also null when the
account has no address on file.

isActive.description: False when the account is deactivated (such users are only returned when `includeInactive=true`).

scheduleGroupIds.description: Ids of the schedule groups the user belongs to (see `/api/v1/schedule-groups`). Empty when unassigned.

UserSummaryDto.description:
A user of the calling organization as exposed to integrations by `GET /api/v1/users`:
display name and schedule-group membership only. No credentials, security stamps or
role details are ever returned. Requires the `scheduling` module.

type.description: URI identifying the problem type (RFC 7807). Currently the generic reference for the HTTP status.

title.description: Short human-readable summary of the status, e.g. "Not Found".

status.description: HTTP status code, repeated from the response line.

detail.description: Explanation specific to this occurrence, e.g. "Job 42 was not found in this organization."

instance.description: Request path the problem occurred on, when known.

errors.description: Validation failures keyed by JSON field name in camelCase (an empty key holds body-level errors); each value is an array of messages, e.g. { "name": ["The Name field is required."] }.

ValidationProblemDetails.description: RFC 7807 problem detail for 400 (malformed/invalid body) and 422 (semantically invalid) responses: the per-field messages are under errors. Also carries a traceId string to quote in support requests.

id.description: Numeric id, usable in `/api/v1/vendors/{id}` and as a purchase order's `vendorId`. Example: `7`.

syncId.description: Stable cross-device id; also the pagination cursor.

name.description: Vendor name, unique in the organization. Example: `Acme Supply`.

description.description: Free-text notes about the vendor; null when not recorded.

contactName.description: Main contact's name; null when not recorded. Example: `Dana Ruiz`.

contactEmail.description: Main contact's email; null when not recorded. Example: `orders@acme.example`.

contactPhone.description: Main contact's phone, as typed; null when not recorded. Example: `555-0100`.

website.description: Vendor website; null when not recorded. Example: `https://acme.example`.

defaultShippingCompany.description: Carrier the vendor usually ships with; null when not recorded. Example: `UPS`.

isActive.description: False for a deactivated vendor: kept for history, not offered on new orders and refused as a new order's `vendorId`.

updatedAt.description: UTC last modification time (ISO-8601).

VendorDto.description:
A vendor (supplier) the organization buys from, as returned by `/api/v1/vendors`. Use the id
as `vendorId` when creating a purchase order.

name.description: Vendor name, 1..100 characters, unique in the organization. Required on create. Example: `Acme Supply`.

description.description: Free-text notes, up to 500 characters.

contactName.description: Main contact's name, up to 100 characters.

contactEmail.description: Main contact's email, up to 100 characters. Example: `orders@acme.example`.

contactPhone.description: Main contact's phone, up to 20 characters. Example: `555-0100`.

defaultShippingCompany.description: Carrier the vendor usually ships with, up to 100 characters. Example: `UPS`.

isActive.description: False deactivates the vendor (kept for history, not offered on new orders). Defaults to `true` on create.

VendorWriteApiRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/vendors` (`name` required) and `PATCH /api/v1/vendors/{id}`
(only the fields sent change; `""` clears a field, except `name`).
Example: `{ "name": "Acme Supply", "contactEmail": "orders@acme.example", "defaultShippingCompany": "UPS" }`.

ViewModels.Items.StockBatchAction.description: What one entry of a stock batch does.

ViewModels.Jobs.TransferRedirectKind.description: Where a redirected line, or a line on a skipped waypoint, goes instead: `Waypoint`, `Destination` or `Location`.

reason.description: Why the invoice is being voided. Recorded in the job's history when the invoice bills a job.

VoidInvoiceRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/invoices/{id}/void`. Optional — send no body (or `{}`) to
void without a reason.

name.description: The event name, e.g. `job.completed`.

WebhookEventsResponse.description: The events a subscription can subscribe to.

id.description: Numeric id of the subscription. Example: `42`.

url.description: The absolute `https` URL that receives the event payloads.

active.description: Whether the subscription is currently delivering. Auto-disables after repeated failures.

createdAt.description: When the subscription was created, ISO-8601 UTC.

signingSecret.description: The HMAC signing secret for verifying the `X-Flex-Signature-V2` (`t=,v1=` over `"."`) and legacy `X-Flex-Signature` headers. Returned only in the response to `POST /api/v1/webhooks` (shown once, never retrievable again); `null` otherwise.

WebhookSubscriptionDto.description:
A webhook subscription: the web host POSTs a signed JSON payload to `url` whenever one of the
subscribed `events` occurs. Used by integration platforms (Zapier, Make) to register an
instant-trigger endpoint per automation.

webhooks.description: Every active subscription for the organization.

ApiKey.description: API key created in Flex. Send as `Authorization: Bearer flx_live_…`.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Subscriptions are created in Flex under Settings → Integrations → Webhooks: a public https URL, the events to receive, and a signing secret shown once. Every delivery is an HTTP POST with `Content-Type: application/json` and the envelope `{ "event", "occurredAt", "organizationId", "data" }` (`occurredAt` is ISO-8601 UTC; `data` is the compact summary documented per event, camelCase, nulls omitted). Headers on every attempt: `X-Flex-Timestamp` (unix seconds when this attempt was signed), `X-Flex-Signature-V2: t=<same unix seconds>,v1=<lowercase hex>` (HMAC-SHA256, keyed with the subscription secret, of the string `<t>.<raw request body>`), `X-Flex-Delivery` (an opaque delivery id, identical on every retry of the same delivery), `X-Flex-Event` (the event name), and the legacy `X-Flex-Signature: sha256=<lowercase hex>` (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body only, kept unchanged for existing integrations). Recommended verification (replay-safe): recompute the `X-Flex-Signature-V2` HMAC over the received bytes before parsing, compare in constant time, reject the request if `t` is more than 300 s (5 minutes) away from your clock, and ignore a `X-Flex-Delivery` you have already processed. Retries are re-signed with a fresh timestamp but keep the same `X-Flex-Delivery`. Any 2xx acknowledges the delivery; anything else, or no answer within 10 s, is retried with exponential backoff up to 5 attempts. After 20 consecutive failed deliveries the subscription is paused (shown inactive) until it is re-enabled. Redirects are never followed and private or link-local addresses are refused. Every attempt (status, timing, response) is listed in the delivery log in Settings.

tags.name: Activity
tags.description:
The organization's API and agent activity log (API_AND_MCP.md "Activity log"): one row
per `/api/v1` or `/mcp` request made with any of its keys, including the MCP
tool an agent called. Requires `ManageOrganizations` — the same gate as the API Keys
and API activity pages. Read-only; served by `IApiActivityService`.

tags.name: Categories
tags.description:
Item categories, their properties — the custom fields every item in a category carries
(Item Categories → Manage Properties in the app) — and the categories assigned to an item.
Reads need `ViewInventory`; writes need `ManageInventory` (the Item Categories page's
gate) and an `Idempotency-Key`, and go through `ICategoryManagementService` /
`ICategoryPropertyService`, the same Flex.Core code as that page. A property definition
applies to items created in or moved to the category afterwards; existing items keep their
properties. The built-in "No Category" is not listed and cannot be changed.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description:
The calling organization's customers and their additional locations (job sites).
Mirrors the MVC Customers pages: reads need `ViewCustomers`, create/update need
`ManageCustomers` on the API key (customer and location writes alike). Soft-deleted
customers are never returned or editable, nor are their locations. Writes go through
`ICustomerService` — the same code the UI uses.

tags.name: Invoices
tags.description:
The organization's invoices: headers, lines, payments and balance, plus creating a draft
from a job or a standalone invoice from lines, finalizing, voiding, deleting drafts and recording payments.
Writes go through `IInvoiceService` exactly like the MVC Invoices pages.

tags.name: ItemProperties
tags.description:
Custom fields: the properties of a catalog item (template) — their definitions (name, data
type, options) and the item's values. Permissions mirror the two app pages exactly: values
and item-level properties are edited in the Items page's item modal (`ManageInventory`,
through `IItemEditService`); a property's name, type and options, and deleting a
property that came from the Item Template, are edited on the Item Templates page
(`ManageTemplates`, through `IItemTemplateService`). Calculated properties are
read-only and the pricing properties `Cost` / `Unit Price` are changed through
`PATCH /api/v1/items/{id}`. Every write answers with the item's full property list.

tags.name: Items
tags.description:
The organization's items (ItemTemplates) with pricing and stock, plus create / partial
update, deactivation and stock adjust/move. Stock semantics match the Items page:
physical rows outside job sites, minus oversold quantity when negative inventory is
allowed, with sub-unit parents reporting a decimal on-hand. Create and update go through
`IItemCatalogService` and deactivation through `IItemBulkActionService` — the
same code the Items pages use.

tags.name: ItemUnits
tags.description:
An item's inventory units — the physical stock rows counted by `onHand` — with their
location, status and per-unit custom-field values. Each unit carries its own copy of the
item's custom fields: it follows the item's value until it is set on the unit (then
`isCustomized`). Reads need `ViewInventory`; setting a unit's value needs
`ManageInventory` (the Inventory edit page's gate) and goes through
`IItemEditService`, the same Flex.Core code as that page.

tags.name: Jobs
tags.description:
Jobs (API_AND_MCP.md). Reads (Phase 1a) need `ViewJobs`; writes (Phase 1b) need
`ManageJobs`, an `Idempotency-Key` header, and go through the same
`IJobWorkflowService` methods as the MVC Jobs pages — this controller only
validates ids against the key's organization and maps results to problem+json. Every
query is scoped to the presented key's organization; ids from other organizations
answer 404. Writes are attributed to the key's creator (`ApiActor`).

tags.name: LaborRates
tags.description:
Read access to the organization's labor rates (API_AND_MCP.md) so callers can discover the
`laborRateId` values that a job's labor line accepts. Requires `ViewJobs`. Retired
rates are excluded unless `includeInactive=true`.

tags.name: Locations
tags.description:
Read access to the organization's stock locations (API_AND_MCP.md) so callers can discover
the `locationId` values that `GET /api/v1/items/{id}` reports stock against and that
`POST /api/v1/items/{id}/stock/adjust` / `/stock/move` accept. Requires
`ViewInventory`. Deleted locations are never returned.

tags.name: Me
tags.description:
Identity of the presented API key (API_AND_MCP.md). A connection-test endpoint for integration
platforms (Zapier, Make) and scripts: any valid key may call it — no extra permission — to confirm
the key works and learn its organization and effective permissions.

tags.name: Modules
tags.description:
Lets an agent or integration discover what it can do before calling anything else.
Reference implementation for the /api/v1 surface.

tags.name: PurchaseOrders
tags.description:
Purchase orders (API_AND_MCP.md). Reads need `ViewPurchaseOrders`; receiving needs
`ManagePurchaseOrders` and an `Idempotency-Key` header and goes through
`IPurchaseOrderService.ReceiveAsync`, the same Flex.Core path as the app's receiving
panel — this controller only maps results to problem+json. Every query is scoped to the
presented key's organization and skips deleted orders; ids from other organizations answer
404. Receipts are attributed to the key's creator (`ApiActor`). Creating orders,
adding lines and the status steps (ordered / shipped / delivered / cancel) go through
`IPurchaseOrderWriteService`, the same path as the purchase-order pages; editing an
order's header, removing lines and per-shipment tracking stay in the app.

tags.name: Reorder
tags.description:
Reorder points and low stock (API_AND_MCP.md "Reorder points & vendor link"): the app's
Reorder → Thresholds rows per item, and the items currently below one of them. Reads need
`ViewInventory` (the office app shows the same low-stock list under it); setting a
reorder point needs `ManageInventory`, the Thresholds page's gate. Everything goes
through Flex.Core `IReorderPointService`; the low-stock list is computed on request and
never writes the alert rows the Reorder page creates.

tags.name: ReorderPoints
tags.description:
Reorder points across all items (API_AND_MCP.md "Reorder points & vendor link"): the
org-wide list of the app's Reorder → Thresholds rows and deleting one. The per-item read and
create-or-update live under `/api/v1/items/{id}/reorder-points`. Listing needs
`ViewInventory`; deleting needs `ManageInventory`, the Thresholds page's gate.
Everything goes through Flex.Core `IReorderPointService`.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description:
Roles (API_AND_MCP.md): the built-in OrganizationAdmin / Manager / User roles and the
organization's custom roles, each with the permissions it grants. Reading needs
`ManageUsers` (to pick a role for an account); creating, editing and deleting custom roles needs
`ManageRoles` — the Roles pages' gate — and goes through Flex.Core
`IRoleAdministrationService`, the same path as those pages. A role may only contain
permissions held by both the API key and its creator. SystemAdmin is never listed.

tags.name: SalesOrders
tags.description:
Sales orders (API_AND_MCP.md). Reads need `ViewSalesOrders`; writes need
`ManageSalesOrders` and an `Idempotency-Key` header and go through
`ISalesOrderService` (create, Begin Fulfillment, Complete) and
`ISalesOrderFulfillmentService` (pick, complete picking, ship, deliver, cancel) — the
same Flex.Core paths as the app's New Sales Order page, item modal, Details page and
Cancel page — this controller only maps results to problem+json. Every query is scoped to
the presented key's organization; ids from other organizations answer 404. Writes are
attributed to the key's creator (`ApiActor`). Header / line edits, line picking, the
manual transfer and returns are in SalesOrdersController.Edits.cs; invoicing stays in the
app. No module gate: sales orders are not a module.

tags.name: Schedule
tags.description:
The organization's calendar of scheduled jobs (API_AND_MCP.md, Phase 1a). Requires the
Scheduling module; without it every call answers 403. Same data and shape as the web
calendar feed (`Jobs/GetCalendarEvents`), produced by the same service.

tags.name: ScheduleGroups
tags.description:
The calling organization's schedule groups (divisions / crews / teams) and their members.
Requires the `scheduling` module. Reads need `ViewJobs` — the same gate as the MVC
assignment picker; writes need `ManageJobs` (the Schedule Groups page's gate) and an
`Idempotency-Key`, and go through `IScheduleGroupService`, the same Flex.Core code as
that page. Deleted groups are never returned.

tags.name: Transfers
tags.description:
Inventory transfers (API_AND_MCP.md). Reads and writes both need `ManageTransfers` —
the Transfers pages and the office app require it for reads too and there is no separate
view permission, so the API is never looser than the pages. Writes need an
`Idempotency-Key` header and go through `ITransferWorkflowService`, the same
Flex.Core façade the Job Details "Create Transfer" / "Cancel" buttons call, over
`IStockTransferService` (the Transfers pages' engine) for standalone transfers — this
controller only maps results to problem+json. Every query is scoped to the presented
key's organization; ids from other organizations answer 404. Writes are attributed to the
key's creator (`ApiActor`).

tags.name: UserRemovalRequests
tags.description:
Organization Admin removal requests (permissions/ROLES_AND_PERMISSIONS.md "Removing an Organization
Admin"). Demoting or deactivating an Organization Admin is refused by `PATCH /api/v1/users/{id}`
and `/deactivate`; instead an Organization Admin asks here, and the change is made when the
target approves, or 14 days later unless the target contests. Asking for your own account steps
you down at once. Nobody can remove the organization's last active Organization Admin. Thin
mapping onto Flex.Core `IAdminRemovalService` (the Users page's path, remote-first through
the sync server, which is the authority); every call is made as the key's creator, so approve /
contest work only with a key created by the admin being removed. Needs `ManageUsers`.

tags.name: Users
tags.description:
The calling organization's users. `GET /api/v1/users` is the scheduling roster (display
names and schedule-group membership; `scheduling` module + `ViewJobs`, the MVC
assignment picker's gate). Everything else is account administration and needs
`ManageUsers` — the Account/UserList page's permission — going through Flex.Core
`IUserAdministrationService`, the same remote-first path as that page (the sync server
creates and re-roles accounts and enforces the hierarchy). Writes are attributed to the key's
creator and limited by `UserAdminRules`: OrganizationAdmin or higher only, never the
caller's own account, only accounts of a strictly lesser role, roles up to the creator's own
(an OrganizationAdmin may promote a Manager / User to OrganizationAdmin), SystemAdmin never assignable,
and nothing may grant a permission the API key (or its creator) does not hold.

tags.name: Vendors
tags.description:
Vendors (API_AND_MCP.md): the suppliers purchase orders are placed with. Reads need
`ViewPurchaseOrders`; creating and editing need `ManageVendors` and an
`Idempotency-Key` and go through `IVendorService`, the same Flex.Core path as the
Vendors pages and the purchase-order page's "new vendor" dialog.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description:
Manage webhook subscriptions over the API (API_AND_MCP.md) — the "REST Hooks" surface integration
platforms (Zapier, Make) use to register and remove an instant-trigger endpoint per automation.
Requires `ManageOrganizations`. Web-host-only, like the rest of `/api/v1`.

post.summary: A job or estimate is created — from the API, the web app or a synced device.
post.description: Outbound: Flex sends this request to your endpoint; you do not call it. Subscriptions are created in Flex under Settings → Integrations → Webhooks: a public https URL, the events to receive, and a signing secret shown once. Every delivery is an HTTP POST with `Content-Type: application/json` and the envelope `{ "event", "occurredAt", "organizationId", "data" }` (`occurredAt` is ISO-8601 UTC; `data` is the compact summary documented per event, camelCase, nulls omitted). Headers on every attempt: `X-Flex-Timestamp` (unix seconds when this attempt was signed), `X-Flex-Signature-V2: t=<same unix seconds>,v1=<lowercase hex>` (HMAC-SHA256, keyed with the subscription secret, of the string `<t>.<raw request body>`), `X-Flex-Delivery` (an opaque delivery id, identical on every retry of the same delivery), `X-Flex-Event` (the event name), and the legacy `X-Flex-Signature: sha256=<lowercase hex>` (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body only, kept unchanged for existing integrations). Recommended verification (replay-safe): recompute the `X-Flex-Signature-V2` HMAC over the received bytes before parsing, compare in constant time, reject the request if `t` is more than 300 s (5 minutes) away from your clock, and ignore a `X-Flex-Delivery` you have already processed. Retries are re-signed with a fresh timestamp but keep the same `X-Flex-Delivery`. Any 2xx acknowledges the delivery; anything else, or no answer within 10 s, is retried with exponential backoff up to 5 attempts. After 20 consecutive failed deliveries the subscription is paused (shown inactive) until it is re-enabled. Redirects are never followed and private or link-local addresses are refused. Every attempt (status, timing, response) is listed in the delivery log in Settings.

parameters.name: X-Flex-Signature
parameters.description: `sha256=<lowercase hex>` — HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body keyed with the subscription secret. Legacy (no replay protection); prefer `X-Flex-Signature-V2`.

parameters.name: X-Flex-Signature-V2
parameters.description: `t=<unix seconds>,v1=<lowercase hex>` — HMAC-SHA256, keyed with the subscription secret, of the string `<t>.<raw request body>`. Reject the delivery when `t` is more than 300 s from your clock. Re-signed with a fresh `t` on every retry.

parameters.name: X-Flex-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix time in seconds (UTC) when this attempt was signed; equal to `t` in `X-Flex-Signature-V2`.

parameters.name: X-Flex-Delivery
parameters.description: Opaque delivery id, the same on every retry of one delivery — store it (e.g. 24 h) and ignore repeats. Unique per subscription; do not parse it.

parameters.name: X-Flex-Event
parameters.description: The event name, identical to the envelope's `event` (handy for routing before parsing the body).

organizationId.description: The organization the subscription belongs to.

schema.description: Signed envelope Flex POSTs to the subscribed URL for `job.created`.

2XX.description: Delivery acknowledged. Any other status, or a timeout, is retried.
